examples.en: A buffalo was resting in the muddy pond near the farm.
examples.zh: 一頭水牛正在農場附近的泥濘池塘裡休息。

examples.en: Farmers in the village still use a buffalo to plow the field.
examples.zh: 村裡的農夫仍然用水牛來犁田。

examples.en: Herds of buffalo once roamed across the wide plains of America.
examples.zh: 野牛群曾經在美洲遼闊的平原上漫遊。

examples.en: The farmer keeps a strong bull in the barn behind his house.
examples.zh: 農夫在屋後的穀倉裡養了一頭強壯的公牛。

examples.en: A bull has two sharp horns on its head.
examples.zh: 公牛的頭上有兩根尖銳的角。

examples.en: The tourists watched a bull eating grass near the fence.
examples.zh: 遊客們看著一頭公牛在圍籬邊吃草。

examples.en: The museum keeps an old bullet in a glass case for visitors.
examples.zh: 博物館把一顆舊子彈放在玻璃櫃裡供遊客參觀。

examples.en: Please add a bullet before each item on the report list.
examples.zh: 請在報告清單的每一項前面加上條列符號。

examples.en: The police officer put the bullet in an evidence bag.
examples.zh: 警察把子彈放進了證物袋。

senses.zh: 碰撞；撞到；偶然遇見；顛簸前進

examples.en: Be careful not to bump your head on the low doorframe.
examples.zh: 小心不要把頭撞到低矮的門框。

examples.en: I bumped into my old classmate at the mall yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天在購物中心巧遇了以前的同學。

examples.en: The old bus began to bump along the rough mountain road.
examples.zh: 那輛老舊的公車開始在崎嶇的山路上顛簸前進。

examples.en: He has a small bump on his forehead after the game.
examples.zh: 比賽後他的額頭上有一個小腫塊。

examples.en: Slow down because there is a bump in the road ahead.
examples.zh: 前方路面有個隆起處，請減速。

examples.en: We felt a bump when the plane landed on the runway.
examples.zh: 飛機降落在跑道上時，我們感覺到一陣顛簸。

examples.en: She bought a bunch of fresh flowers for her mother.
examples.zh: 她買了一束新鮮的花送給媽媽。

examples.en: He ate a bunch of grapes after lunch.
examples.zh: 他午餐後吃了一串葡萄。

examples.en: A bunch of students were waiting outside the classroom.
examples.zh: 一群學生正在教室外面等候。

examples.en: The dog likes to bury its bone in the garden.
examples.zh: 那隻狗喜歡把牠的骨頭埋在花園裡。

examples.en: Fallen leaves buried the path after the autumn storm.
examples.zh: 秋季暴風雨過後，落葉掩埋了小徑。

examples.en: She wants to bury the bad memories and start again.
examples.zh: 她想把不好的回憶埋藏起來，重新開始。

examples.en: A small bird was hiding in the bush beside the road.
examples.zh: 一隻小鳥躲在路邊的灌木叢裡。

examples.en: Dad cut the bush in front of our house on Sunday.
examples.zh: 爸爸星期天修剪了我們家門前的灌木。

examples.en: There are red berries on the bush near the school gate.
examples.zh: 校門口附近的灌木上結著紅色的漿果。

senses.zh: 發出嗡嗡聲；震動作響；充滿嘈雜聲

examples.en: Bees buzz around the flowers in the garden every spring.
examples.zh: 每年春天，蜜蜂都在花園裡的花叢間嗡嗡飛舞。

examples.en: My phone began to buzz during the meeting.
examples.zh: 開會時我的手機開始震動作響。

examples.en: The classroom buzzed with excitement before the school trip.
examples.zh: 校外教學前，教室裡充滿興奮的嘈雜聲。

examples.en: We heard the buzz of a fly near the window.
examples.zh: 我們聽到窗邊有隻蒼蠅發出嗡嗡聲。

examples.en: A low buzz came from the old refrigerator all night.
examples.zh: 老舊的冰箱整晚都發出低低的嗡嗡聲。

examples.en: The new movie created a lot of buzz online.
examples.zh: 這部新電影在網路上引起了熱烈討論。

examples.en: Our family stayed in a wooden cabin near the lake.
examples.zh: 我們一家人住在湖邊的一間小木屋裡。

examples.en: Passengers must fasten their seat belts in the cabin during takeoff.
examples.zh: 起飛時，乘客必須在機艙內繫好安全帶。

examples.en: The captain showed us our small cabin on the ship.
examples.zh: 船長帶我們看了船上的小艙房。

examples.en: The river cuts through a deep canyon in the mountains.
examples.zh: 這條河流穿過山中一道深邃的峽谷。

examples.en: We took many photos at the edge of the canyon.
examples.zh: 我們在峽谷邊緣拍了很多照片。

examples.en: Hikers walked slowly down into the canyon at sunrise.
examples.zh: 健行者在日出時慢慢走進峽谷。

senses.zh: 有能力的；能幹的；能夠的

examples.en: She is a capable manager who solves problems quickly.
examples.zh: 她是一位能幹的經理，能迅速解決問題。

examples.en: The new phone is capable of recording clear videos.
examples.zh: 這支新手機能夠錄製清晰的影片。

examples.en: Are you capable of carrying this heavy box alone?
examples.zh: 你有辦法自己搬這個很重的箱子嗎？

examples.en: The photographer wanted to capture the beautiful sunset over the sea.
examples.zh: 攝影師想捕捉海上美麗的夕陽。

examples.en: Staff captured the escaped monkey and returned it to the zoo.
examples.zh: 工作人員抓到逃走的猴子，把牠送回了動物園。

examples.en: The movie captures the spirit of a small town very well.
examples.zh: 這部電影把小鎮的風情生動地呈現了出來。

examples.en: The carpenter built a new table for our kitchen.
examples.zh: 木匠為我們的廚房做了一張新桌子。

examples.en: My uncle works as a carpenter in Taichung.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在台中當木匠。

examples.en: A skilled carpenter can repair old wooden chairs easily.
examples.zh: 手藝好的木匠可以輕鬆修好舊的木椅。

examples.en: The princess rode in a carriage to the palace.
examples.zh: 公主搭乘馬車前往皇宮。

examples.en: Please move to the next carriage because this one is full.
examples.zh: 這節車廂已經客滿，請移到下一節車廂。

examples.en: A mother pushed a baby carriage through the park.
examples.zh: 一位媽媽推著嬰兒車走過公園。

examples.en: Please put the groceries in the shopping cart.
examples.zh: 請把雜貨放進購物車裡。

examples.en: A vendor sold fresh fruit from a small cart near the station.
examples.zh: 一位小販在車站附近的小攤車上賣新鮮水果。

examples.en: The porter pushed a cart full of suitcases through the lobby.
examples.zh: 行李員推著一輛載滿行李箱的手推車穿過大廳。

examples.en: The fisherman cast his line into the quiet lake.
examples.zh: 漁夫把釣線拋進平靜的湖裡。

examples.en: The tall tree cast a long shadow on the grass.
examples.zh: 那棵高大的樹在草地上投下長長的影子。

examples.en: The director cast a young actress as the princess.
examples.zh: 導演選了一位年輕女演員來演公主。

senses.zh: 全體演員；石膏繃帶；鑄件

examples.en: The whole cast thanked the audience after the school play.
examples.zh: 學校戲劇演出結束後，全體演員向觀眾致謝。

examples.en: He wore a cast on his arm for six weeks.
examples.zh: 他的手臂打了六週的石膏。

examples.en: A bronze cast of the statue stands in the lobby.
examples.zh: 大廳裡擺著一尊那座雕像的銅鑄複製品。

senses.zh: 休閒的；隨意的；非正式的

examples.en: You can wear casual clothes to the school picnic.
examples.zh: 你可以穿休閒服去參加學校野餐。

examples.en: We had a casual chat before the meeting started.
examples.zh: 會議開始前，我們隨意聊了幾句。

examples.en: Our office has a casual dress code on Fridays.
examples.zh: 我們辦公室在星期五的服裝規定比較休閒。

examples.en: The farmer raises cattle on a large ranch.
examples.zh: 那位農夫在一座大牧場上養牛。

examples.en: Cattle were eating grass beside the river.
examples.zh: 牛群正在河邊吃草。

examples.en: Many cattle crossed the road, so the bus had to stop.
examples.zh: 許多牛穿越馬路，所以公車必須停下來。

examples.en: Bats sleep in the dark cave during the day.
examples.zh: 蝙蝠白天都睡在黑暗的洞穴裡。

examples.en: The students visited a cave near the beach on their trip.
examples.zh: 學生們在旅行時參觀了海邊附近的一個洞穴。

examples.en: We used flashlights to explore the cave safely.
examples.zh: 我們用手電筒安全地探索了這個山洞。

examples.en: Our school team became the national champion last year.
examples.zh: 我們學校的隊伍去年成為全國冠軍。

examples.en: She is the swimming champion of the city.
examples.zh: 她是這座城市的游泳冠軍。

examples.en: The champion received a gold medal and a big trophy.
examples.zh: 冠軍獲頒一面金牌和一座大獎盃。

examples.en: The old town has a special charm that attracts many tourists.
examples.zh: 這座老城鎮有一種特別的魅力，吸引了許多遊客。

examples.en: Her charm made everyone in the room smile happily.
examples.zh: 她的魅力讓房間裡的每個人都開心地微笑。

examples.en: She wore a bracelet with a small silver charm.
examples.zh: 她戴著一條有小銀吊飾的手鍊。

examples.en: The singer charmed the audience with her sweet voice.
examples.zh: 那位歌手用甜美的嗓音迷住了觀眾。

examples.en: The little boy charmed his teacher with a big smile.
examples.zh: 小男孩用燦爛的笑容打動了老師。

examples.en: The magician charmed the children with simple card tricks.
examples.zh: 魔術師用簡單的紙牌戲法迷住了孩子們。

examples.en: The baby has soft pink cheeks and a bright smile.
examples.zh: 這個寶寶臉頰粉嫩柔軟，笑容燦爛。

examples.en: She kissed her grandmother on the cheek before leaving.
examples.zh: 她離開前親了親奶奶的臉頰。

examples.en: A tear ran slowly down his cheek during the sad movie.
examples.zh: 看這部悲傷的電影時，一滴眼淚慢慢滑過他的臉頰。

senses.zh: 開朗的；愉快的；明亮宜人的

examples.en: Our new neighbor is a cheerful old lady.
examples.zh: 我們的新鄰居是一位開朗的老太太。

examples.en: The cheerful music made everyone want to dance.
examples.zh: 歡快的音樂讓每個人都想跳舞。

examples.en: The kitchen looks cheerful with its bright yellow curtains.
examples.zh: 廚房掛著明亮的黃色窗簾，看起來很宜人。

examples.en: She put a red cherry on top of the cake.
examples.zh: 她在蛋糕上放了一顆紅櫻桃。

examples.en: We picked cherries from the tree behind our house.
examples.zh: 我們從屋後的樹上摘了櫻桃。

examples.en: The cherry tree in our yard is full of flowers in spring.
examples.zh: 我們院子裡的櫻桃樹在春天開滿了花。

examples.en: The doctor listened to my chest with a stethoscope.
examples.zh: 醫生用聽診器聽我的胸部。

examples.en: He felt his heart pounding in his chest after the race.
examples.zh: 賽跑結束後，他感覺到心臟在胸口怦怦跳。

examples.en: The old toy chest is full of my childhood things.
examples.zh: 那個舊玩具箱裡裝滿了我童年的東西。

examples.en: There was a chill in the air this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上空氣中有一股寒意。

examples.en: Put on a coat to keep out the autumn chill.
examples.zh: 穿上外套來抵擋秋天的涼意。

examples.en: I caught a chill after swimming in the cold lake.
examples.zh: 我在冰冷的湖裡游泳後著涼了。

examples.en: Chill the juice in the fridge before dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐前先把果汁放進冰箱冷藏。

examples.en: Cold winds chilled the whole town overnight.
examples.zh: 冷風一夜之間讓整座小鎮變得寒冷。

examples.en: We just chill at home on rainy Sundays.
examples.zh: 下雨的星期天，我們只是在家放鬆。

examples.en: It was a chilly morning, so I wore a jacket.
examples.zh: 那天早上涼颼颼的，所以我穿了外套。

examples.en: The room felt chilly because the window was open.
examples.zh: 窗戶開著，所以房間感覺很冷。

examples.en: Bring a sweater because the evenings are chilly here.
examples.zh: 這裡的傍晚很涼，記得帶一件毛衣。

examples.en: Smoke rose from the chimney of the small house.
examples.zh: 煙從那間小房子的煙囪裡冒出來。

examples.en: In the story, Santa Claus comes down the chimney.
examples.zh: 故事裡，聖誕老公公從煙囪爬下來。

examples.en: A bird built its nest on top of the old chimney.
examples.zh: 一隻鳥在舊煙囪頂端築了巢。

examples.en: We shared a bag of potato chips at the movie.
examples.zh: 我們看電影時分著吃了一包洋芋片。

examples.en: This tiny chip controls the whole machine.
examples.zh: 這片小小的晶片控制著整台機器。

examples.en: There is a small chip on the edge of my cup.
examples.zh: 我的杯緣有一個小缺口。

examples.en: Please chop the onions into small pieces.
examples.zh: 請把洋蔥切成小塊。

examples.en: He used an axe to chop wood for the fireplace.
examples.zh: 他用斧頭劈柴給壁爐用。

examples.en: Workers chop down old trees along the road before typhoon season.
examples.zh: 颱風季節前，工人會砍掉路邊的老樹。

examples.en: I ordered a pork chop with rice for lunch.
examples.zh: 我午餐點了一份豬排配飯。

examples.en: The restaurant serves a lamb chop with roasted vegetables.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳供應搭配烤蔬菜的羊排。

examples.en: Dad grilled a few chops for the family barbecue.
examples.zh: 爸爸為家庭烤肉烤了幾塊肉排。

examples.en: No one may light a cigarette inside the train station.
examples.zh: 任何人都不得在火車站內點菸。

examples.en: He decided to stop buying cigarettes to save money.
examples.zh: 他決定不再買菸來省錢。

examples.en: Doctors say that each cigarette harms your lungs.
examples.zh: 醫生說每一根菸都會傷害你的肺。

examples.en: We watched a new cartoon at the cinema on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我們星期六在電影院看了一部新的卡通。

examples.en: There is a big cinema next to the shopping mall.
examples.zh: 購物中心旁邊有一間大電影院。

examples.en: She studies cinema at a university in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她在台北的一所大學修讀電影藝術。

examples.en: The circus came to our town last weekend.
examples.zh: 馬戲團上週末來到了我們的小鎮。

examples.en: Children laughed at the funny performers in the circus.
examples.zh: 孩子們被馬戲團裡有趣的表演者逗得哈哈大笑。

examples.en: My brother dreams of joining a circus as a juggler.
examples.zh: 我弟弟夢想加入馬戲團當雜耍演員。

senses.zh: 公民的；有禮貌的；土木的

examples.en: Every citizen has civil rights in a free country.
examples.zh: 在自由的國家裡，每位公民都享有公民權利。

examples.en: Please be civil when you disagree with others.
examples.zh: 與人意見不同時，請保持禮貌。

examples.en: Civil engineers designed the new bridge in our city.
examples.zh: 土木工程師設計了我們城市裡的新橋。

examples.en: The children made little animals out of clay.
examples.zh: 孩子們用黏土做了小動物。

examples.en: This pot is made of red clay.
examples.zh: 這個壺是用紅色陶土做成的。

examples.en: Wet clay is soft and easy to shape.
examples.zh: 濕的黏土很柔軟，容易塑形。

examples.en: The cleaner mops the school hallway after classes end.
examples.zh: 下課後，清潔人員會拖學校的走廊。

examples.en: Mom bought a new cleaner for the bathroom.
examples.zh: 媽媽買了一瓶新的浴室清潔劑。

examples.en: Our vacuum cleaner is too loud for the baby.
examples.zh: 我們的吸塵器對寶寶來說太吵了。

examples.en: The lawyer met a new client this morning.
examples.zh: 律師今天早上見了一位新的委託人。

examples.en: Our team is preparing a presentation for an important client.
examples.zh: 我們的團隊正在為一位重要客戶準備簡報。

examples.en: The company sent an email to every client.
examples.zh: 公司寄了一封電子郵件給每一位客戶。

examples.en: My mother took me to the clinic because of a fever.
examples.zh: 我發燒，媽媽帶我去診所。

examples.en: A new dental clinic opened near the station.
examples.zh: 車站附近新開了一間牙科診所。

examples.en: The clinic is closed on Sunday afternoons.
examples.zh: 這間診所星期天下午休診。

examples.en: She used a clip to hold the papers together.
examples.zh: 她用夾子把紙張夾在一起。

examples.en: We watched a funny clip about a talking parrot.
examples.zh: 我們看了一段關於會說話的鸚鵡的搞笑短片。

examples.en: She wore a blue clip in her hair.
examples.zh: 她的頭髮上別著一個藍色髮夾。

examples.en: Clip the coupon from the newspaper before you go shopping.
examples.zh: 購物前，先從報紙上剪下優惠券。

examples.en: He clipped the microphone to his shirt.
examples.zh: 他把麥克風夾在襯衫上。

examples.en: Dad clips the hedge in our garden every month.
examples.zh: 爸爸每個月都會修剪我們花園裡的樹籬。

examples.en: The charity helps to clothe children in need.
examples.zh: 這個慈善機構協助有需要的孩子獲得衣物。

examples.en: Parents work hard to feed and clothe their families.
examples.zh: 父母努力工作，讓家人有飯吃、有衣服穿。

examples.en: She clothed the baby in a warm sweater.
examples.zh: 她給寶寶穿上了一件暖和的毛衣。

examples.en: The clown made the children laugh at the birthday party.
examples.zh: 小丑在生日派對上逗得孩子們哈哈大笑。

examples.en: My cousin dressed as a clown for Halloween.
examples.zh: 我表哥萬聖節時扮成小丑。

examples.en: He is the class clown, so everyone enjoys his jokes.
examples.zh: 他是班上的活寶，所以大家都喜歡他的笑話。

examples.en: The detective found an important clue in the garden.
examples.zh: 偵探在花園裡發現了一條重要的線索。

examples.en: Can you give me a clue about the answer?
examples.zh: 你可以給我一點答案的提示嗎？

examples.en: The map led us to the next clue in the game.
examples.zh: 地圖帶我們找到遊戲中的下一條線索。

examples.en: A cock crowed loudly at dawn and woke the farmer.
examples.zh: 一隻公雞在黎明時大聲啼叫，叫醒了農夫。

examples.en: The farmer fed the cock and the hens every morning.
examples.zh: 農夫每天早上餵公雞和母雞。

examples.en: On the farm, the cock woke us up early.
examples.zh: 在農場裡，公雞很早就把我們叫醒了。

examples.en: The bartender mixed a colorful cocktail for a guest.
examples.zh: 調酒師為一位客人調了一杯色彩繽紛的雞尾酒。

examples.en: The hotel held a cocktail party for new guests.
examples.zh: 飯店為新住客舉辦了一場雞尾酒會。

examples.en: Mom ordered a fruit cocktail for dessert after dinner.
examples.zh: 媽媽晚餐後點了一份什錦水果當甜點。

examples.en: We drank fresh coconut water on the beach.
examples.zh: 我們在海灘上喝了新鮮的椰子水。

examples.en: The monkey climbed the tree to pick a coconut.
examples.zh: 猴子爬上樹去摘椰子。

examples.en: She added grated coconut to the cake for extra flavor.
examples.zh: 她在蛋糕裡加入椰肉絲，增添風味。

examples.en: He fixed the collar of his white shirt.
examples.zh: 他整理了白襯衫的衣領。

examples.en: The dog wears a red collar with its name on it.
examples.zh: 那隻狗戴著一個寫有牠名字的紅色項圈。

examples.en: This coat has a warm fur collar.
examples.zh: 這件外套有溫暖的毛皮領子。

examples.en: Many countries once had colonies in Asia and Africa.
examples.zh: 許多國家曾經在亞洲和非洲擁有殖民地。

examples.en: An ant colony can contain thousands of ants.
examples.zh: 一個蟻群可以有好幾千隻螞蟻。

examples.en: The students learned how a bee colony makes honey.
examples.zh: 學生們學到了蜂群是如何製造蜂蜜的。

examples.en: Tall stone columns stand in front of the museum.
examples.zh: 高大的石柱矗立在博物館前面。

examples.en: My father reads a sports column every morning.
examples.zh: 我爸爸每天早上都會讀一篇體育專欄。

examples.en: Write your name in the first column of the table.
examples.zh: 請把你的名字寫在表格的第一欄。

examples.en: This sofa offers great comfort after a long day.
examples.zh: 忙了一整天後，這張沙發讓人覺得非常舒適。

examples.en: Her kind words were a great comfort to me.
examples.zh: 她親切的話語對我是很大的安慰。

examples.en: She felt comfort in knowing her family was safe.
examples.zh: 知道家人平安，她感到很寬慰。

examples.en: She tried to comfort her crying little brother.
examples.zh: 她試著安慰哭泣的弟弟。

examples.en: The teacher comforted the students after the exam.
examples.zh: 考試後，老師安慰了學生們。

examples.en: A warm hug can comfort a person who feels sad.
examples.zh: 一個溫暖的擁抱可以安慰難過的人。

examples.en: The school committee will choose a new principal.
examples.zh: 學校委員會將選出一位新校長。

examples.en: She joined the planning committee for the sports day.
examples.zh: 她加入了運動會的籌備委員會。

examples.en: A committee of parents organized the school festival.
examples.zh: 一個由家長組成的委員會籌辦了校慶活動。

examples.en: Good friends communicate openly with each other.
examples.zh: 好朋友之間會坦誠地溝通。

examples.en: You can communicate with our office by email.
examples.zh: 你可以透過電子郵件與我們辦公室聯絡。

examples.en: Teachers must communicate the rules clearly to students.
examples.zh: 老師必須向學生清楚傳達規定。

examples.en: The comparison between the two phones helped me decide.
examples.zh: 兩支手機的比較幫助我做了決定。

examples.en: There is no comparison between the old and new designs.
examples.zh: 新舊設計根本無法相比。

examples.en: Her comparison of life to a journey was easy to understand.
examples.zh: 她把人生比作旅程的說法很容易理解。

examples.en: Many students compete for the same scholarship.
examples.zh: 許多學生爭取同一項獎學金。

examples.en: Our team will compete in the final match on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我們的隊伍星期六將參加決賽。

examples.en: Small shops find it hard to compete with big stores.
examples.zh: 小商店很難和大型商店競爭。

examples.en: We received a complaint about the noise last night.
examples.zh: 我們收到了關於昨晚噪音的投訴。

examples.en: She made a complaint to the hotel manager.
examples.zh: 她向飯店經理提出投訴。

examples.en: His only complaint is that the soup is too salty.
examples.zh: 他唯一的不滿是湯太鹹了。

examples.en: We bought two tickets for the concert next Friday.
examples.zh: 我們買了兩張下週五音樂會的票。

examples.en: The school choir will give a concert in the hall.
examples.zh: 學校合唱團將在禮堂舉辦音樂會。

examples.en: Thousands of fans came to the concert in the park.
examples.zh: 數千名歌迷來到公園參加演唱會。

examples.en: The scientist reached a clear conclusion after the test.
examples.zh: 科學家在實驗後得出了明確的結論。

examples.en: In conclusion, regular exercise is good for your health.
examples.zh: 總而言之，規律運動對健康有益。

examples.en: The conclusion of the movie surprised the audience.
examples.zh: 電影的結尾讓觀眾大吃一驚。

examples.en: The teacher drew a cone on the blackboard.
examples.zh: 老師在黑板上畫了一個圓錐體。

examples.en: I'd like an ice cream cone with two scoops.
examples.zh: 我想要一支兩球的冰淇淋甜筒。

examples.en: Workers put an orange cone beside the hole in the road.
examples.zh: 工人在路上的坑洞旁放了一個橘色三角錐。

examples.en: Please connect the printer to your laptop.
examples.zh: 請把印表機連接到你的筆記型電腦。

examples.en: This bridge connects the island to the mainland.
examples.zh: 這座橋把小島和本土連接起來。

examples.en: I can't connect to the Wi-Fi in this room.
examples.zh: 我在這個房間無法連上無線網路。

senses.zh: 有意識的；意識到的；刻意的

examples.en: The patient was awake and fully conscious.
examples.zh: 病人醒著，意識完全清楚。

examples.en: I am conscious of the time, so I will be brief.
examples.zh: 我知道時間有限，所以會長話短說。

examples.en: She made a conscious effort to speak more slowly.
examples.zh: 她刻意努力讓自己說話慢一點。

senses.zh: 相當大的；可觀的；相當多的

examples.en: The new road saved us a considerable amount of time.
examples.zh: 新路為我們省下了相當多的時間。

examples.en: He spent a considerable sum on a used car.
examples.zh: 他花了一大筆錢買二手車。

examples.en: The storm caused considerable damage to the town.
examples.zh: 暴風雨對小鎮造成了相當大的損害。

examples.en: The constant noise from the street kept me awake.
examples.zh: 街上持續不斷的噪音讓我睡不著。

examples.en: Keep the water at a constant temperature.
examples.zh: 請讓水溫保持恆定。

examples.en: She is my constant companion on every trip.
examples.zh: 她是我每趟旅行中不變的夥伴。

examples.en: In this formula, pi is a constant.
examples.zh: 在這個公式裡，圓周率是一個常數。

examples.en: Change is the only constant in life.
examples.zh: 變化是人生中唯一不變的事。

examples.en: The value of the constant stays the same in every test.
examples.zh: 這個常數的值在每次測驗中都不變。

examples.en: Asia is the largest continent in the world.
examples.zh: 亞洲是世界上最大的洲。

examples.en: Penguins live on the cold southern continent.
examples.zh: 企鵝生活在寒冷的南方大陸上。

examples.en: Which continent would you like to visit first?
examples.zh: 你最想先去哪一個洲旅行？

examples.en: My mother cooks rice in an electric rice cooker.
examples.zh: 我媽媽用電鍋煮飯。

examples.en: We bought a new gas cooker for the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我們為廚房買了一台新的瓦斯爐。

examples.en: This slow cooker makes soup while we are at work.
examples.zh: 這個慢燉鍋在我們上班時就把湯煮好了。

examples.en: Repairing the old car would be too costly.
examples.zh: 修理這輛舊車的花費太高了。

examples.en: A costly mistake can ruin a good plan.
examples.zh: 一個代價高昂的錯誤可能毀掉一個好計畫。

examples.en: Staying at that hotel is costly in the summer.
examples.zh: 夏天住那家飯店很貴。

examples.en: The baby fell asleep in the wooden cradle.
examples.zh: 寶寶在木製搖籃裡睡著了。

examples.en: Greece is often called the cradle of Western culture.
examples.zh: 希臘常被稱為西方文化的發源地。

examples.en: She gently rocked the cradle until the baby fell asleep.
examples.zh: 她輕輕搖著搖籃，直到寶寶睡著。

examples.en: She cradled the sleeping kitten in her arms.
examples.zh: 她把熟睡的小貓輕輕抱在懷裡。

examples.en: He cradled the phone against his shoulder while typing.
examples.zh: 他一邊打字一邊用肩膀夾住電話。

examples.en: The nurse cradled the baby carefully while checking his temperature.
examples.zh: 護理師量體溫時，小心地托抱著寶寶。

examples.en: A white crane stood still beside the river.
examples.zh: 一隻白鶴靜靜地站在河邊。

examples.en: A tall crane lifted the steel beams onto the roof.
examples.zh: 一台高大的起重機把鋼樑吊到屋頂上。

examples.en: Paper cranes are a symbol of hope in Japan.
examples.zh: 紙鶴在日本是希望的象徵。

examples.en: There was a crash outside the store window.
examples.zh: 商店窗外傳來一聲巨響。

examples.en: Two cars were damaged in the crash on the highway.
examples.zh: 高速公路上的撞車事故讓兩輛車受損。

examples.en: The crash of my computer made me lose my homework.
examples.zh: 電腦當機讓我的作業不見了。

examples.en: The truck crashed into a wall near the school.
examples.zh: 卡車撞上了學校附近的一面牆。

examples.en: My laptop crashes whenever I open this program.
examples.zh: 我一打開這個程式，筆記型電腦就會當機。

examples.en: Waves crashed against the rocks all night.
examples.zh: 海浪整晚拍打著岩石。

examples.en: The baby can crawl across the living room now.
examples.zh: 寶寶現在可以爬過客廳了。

examples.en: Traffic crawled along the highway during the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期期間車流在高速公路上緩慢爬行。

examples.en: A snail crawled slowly up the wall.
examples.zh: 一隻蝸牛慢慢爬上牆壁。

examples.en: The traffic slowed to a crawl near the tunnel.
examples.zh: 隧道附近的車流慢到幾乎爬行。

examples.en: He switched from the crawl to the backstroke.
examples.zh: 他從自由式換成了仰式。

examples.en: We moved at a crawl through the crowded market.
examples.zh: 我們在擁擠的市場裡慢慢前進。

examples.en: She is a creative girl who loves painting.
examples.zh: 她是個愛畫畫、很有創意的女孩。

examples.en: We need a creative way to solve this problem.
examples.zh: 我們需要一個有創意的方法來解決這個問題。

examples.en: The class gave students a creative writing task.
examples.zh: 這堂課讓學生做創意寫作的作業。

examples.en: The creator of the cartoon visited our school.
examples.zh: 這部卡通的創作者來到了我們學校。

examples.en: Each video creator has a different style.
examples.zh: 每位影片創作者都有自己的風格。

examples.en: Many people see the artist as the creator of this city's image.
examples.zh: 許多人認為這位藝術家是這座城市形象的締造者。

examples.en: The deep sea is home to many strange creatures.
examples.zh: 深海是許多奇特生物的家。

examples.en: A small furry creature ran across the path.
examples.zh: 一隻毛茸茸的小動物跑過小徑。

examples.en: The movie is about a friendly creature from space.
examples.zh: 這部電影是關於一個來自太空的友善生物。

examples.en: You can buy goods on credit at this shop.
examples.zh: 你可以在這家店賒帳購買商品。

examples.en: I need three more credits to graduate.
examples.zh: 我還需要三個學分才能畢業。

examples.en: She deserves credit for organizing the whole event.
examples.zh: 她籌辦整場活動，值得讚揚。

examples.en: The bank credited the money to my account yesterday.
examples.zh: 銀行昨天已把這筆錢存入我的帳戶。

examples.en: They credited the team with the idea.
examples.zh: 他們把這個點子的功勞歸給了這個團隊。

examples.en: The shop will credit your card within five days.
examples.zh: 商店會在五天內把款項退回你的卡片。

senses.zh: 全體工作人員；機組人員；團隊

examples.en: The flight crew welcomed us on board.
examples.zh: 機組人員在登機時歡迎我們。

examples.en: A film crew is shooting a scene on our street.
examples.zh: 一個攝影團隊正在我們這條街上拍攝一場戲。

examples.en: The ship's crew worked together through the storm.
examples.zh: 船員們同心協力度過了暴風雨。

examples.en: Cricket is a popular sport in India and England.
examples.zh: 板球在印度和英格蘭是很受歡迎的運動。

examples.en: We heard a cricket singing outside the window.
examples.zh: 我們聽到窗外有一隻蟋蟀在鳴叫。

examples.en: My uncle watches a cricket match every weekend.
examples.zh: 我叔叔每個週末都會看一場板球比賽。

examples.en: The police caught the criminal after a long search.
examples.zh: 警方經過長時間搜尋後逮捕了這名罪犯。

examples.en: A young criminal was sent to a special school.
examples.zh: 一名年輕罪犯被送去特別的學校。

examples.en: The movie tells the story of a famous criminal.
examples.zh: 這部電影講述一名著名罪犯的故事。

examples.en: He has no criminal record and hopes to work at a bank.
examples.zh: 他沒有犯罪紀錄，希望到銀行工作。

examples.en: Stealing is a criminal act that can lead to serious consequences.
examples.zh: 偷竊是可能造成嚴重後果的犯罪行為。

examples.en: The lawyer works on criminal cases and often appears in court.
examples.zh: 這位律師處理刑事案件，經常出庭。

examples.en: I love the crispy skin on fried chicken.
examples.zh: 我喜歡炸雞酥脆的外皮。

examples.en: These crispy potato chips are my favorite snack.
examples.zh: 這些香脆的洋芋片是我最愛的零食。

examples.en: The toast should be warm and crispy.
examples.zh: 吐司應該又熱又酥脆。

examples.en: Rice is the main crop in this region.
examples.zh: 稻米是這個地區的主要農作物。

examples.en: Heavy rain destroyed most of the crop this year.
examples.zh: 今年大雨毀掉了大部分的收成。

examples.en: Farmers planted a new crop of corn in spring.
examples.zh: 農夫在春天種下了新一批玉米。

examples.en: Please crop the photo to remove the edges.
examples.zh: 請把照片裁剪掉邊緣。

examples.en: He cropped the picture to fit the frame.
examples.zh: 他把圖片剪裁成適合相框的大小。

examples.en: The gardener cropped the grass very short.
examples.zh: 園丁把草剪得很短。

examples.en: The queen wore a gold crown at the ceremony.
examples.zh: 女王在典禮上戴著一頂金色王冠。

examples.en: The crown of the hat was covered in flowers.
examples.zh: 帽子的頂部覆滿了花朵。

examples.en: Our team won the national crown last year.
examples.zh: 我們隊伍去年贏得了全國冠軍頭銜。

examples.en: The plates are in the cupboard above the sink.
examples.zh: 盤子放在水槽上方的櫥櫃裡。

examples.en: My mother keeps rice and noodles in the kitchen cupboard.
examples.zh: 我媽媽把米和麵條放在廚房櫥櫃裡。

examples.en: He hid the cookies at the back of the cupboard.
examples.zh: 他把餅乾藏在櫥櫃的最裡面。

examples.en: She avoids dairy because milk and cheese upset her stomach.
examples.zh: 她避免食用乳製品，因為牛奶和起司會讓她胃不舒服。

examples.en: The dairy delivers fresh milk every morning.
examples.zh: 乳品店每天早上送來新鮮牛奶。

examples.en: We visited a dairy and saw the cows being milked.
examples.zh: 我們參觀了一座酪農場，看到乳牛被擠奶。

examples.en: I can't eat dairy food because of my allergy.
examples.zh: 我因為過敏不能吃乳製食品。

examples.en: She works on a dairy farm in the countryside.
examples.zh: 她在鄉下的酪農場工作。

examples.en: Dairy cows need a lot of fresh water.
examples.zh: 乳牛需要大量乾淨的水。

examples.en: The dam provides water and power for the city.
examples.zh: 這座水壩為城市提供水和電力。

examples.en: Visitors can walk across the top of the dam.
examples.zh: 遊客可以走過水壩的頂部。

examples.en: Beavers built a small dam across the stream.
examples.zh: 河狸在小溪上築了一座小水壩。

examples.en: I wouldn't dare to speak to the principal like that.
examples.zh: 我不敢那樣對校長說話。

examples.en: Nobody dared to open the old door.
examples.zh: 沒有人敢打開那扇舊門。

examples.en: My friend dared me to try the spicy noodles.
examples.zh: 我的朋友激我試試那碗辣麵。

examples.en: He jumped into the cold pool on a dare.
examples.zh: 他因為被挑戰而跳進冰冷的游泳池。

examples.en: It was a dare, but she didn't take it.
examples.zh: 那是一個挑戰，但她沒有接受。

examples.en: Truth or dare is a popular party game.
examples.zh: 真心話大冒險是很受歡迎的派對遊戲。

examples.en: Thank you, darling, for the lovely card.
examples.zh: 謝謝你，親愛的，這張卡片真可愛。

examples.en: The baby is the darling of the whole family.
examples.zh: 這個寶寶是全家的寶貝。

examples.en: Come here, darling, and meet my friend.
examples.zh: 過來，寶貝，來認識我的朋友。

examples.en: My darling daughter just turned ten and celebrated with her classmates.
examples.zh: 我親愛的女兒剛滿十歲，和同學們一起慶祝。

examples.en: She wore a darling little hat to the picnic.
examples.zh: 她戴了一頂可愛的小帽子去野餐。

examples.en: Your darling puppy has big brown eyes and a tiny nose.
examples.zh: 你那隻可愛的小狗有棕色的大眼睛和小巧的鼻子。

examples.en: I have to dash to catch the last bus.
examples.zh: 我得趕快衝去搭末班公車。

examples.en: The children dashed out of the classroom at noon.
examples.zh: 孩子們中午衝出了教室。

examples.en: She dashed to the store before it closed.
examples.zh: 她在商店打烊前匆忙地跑了過去。

examples.en: He won the hundred-meter dash at school.
examples.zh: 他在學校的一百公尺短跑比賽中獲勝。

examples.en: Add a dash of salt to the soup.
examples.zh: 在湯裡加一點點鹽。

examples.en: Use a dash to show a short pause in your sentence.
examples.zh: 用破折號來表示句子中的短暫停頓。

examples.en: The town has changed a lot in the past decade.
examples.zh: 小鎮在過去十年變化很大。

examples.en: She has worked at this company for over a decade.
examples.zh: 她在這家公司工作超過十年了。

examples.en: The first decade of the century was full of change.
examples.zh: 本世紀的第一個十年充滿了變化。

examples.en: Passengers walked along the deck to watch the sunset.
examples.zh: 乘客沿著甲板散步看夕陽。

examples.en: We had dinner on the wooden deck behind the house.
examples.zh: 我們在屋後的木平台上吃晚餐。

examples.en: Can you shuffle this deck of cards for us?
examples.zh: 你可以幫我們洗這副牌嗎？

examples.en: Helping the old man was a kind deed.
examples.zh: 幫助那位老先生是一件善行。

examples.en: The mayor was praised for his brave deeds.
examples.zh: 市長因勇敢的事蹟而受到讚揚。

examples.en: They signed the deed to the house yesterday.
examples.zh: 他們昨天簽署了這棟房子的所有權契約。

examples.en: Please look up the definition of this word in the dictionary.
examples.zh: 請在字典裡查這個字的定義。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to write our own definition of honesty.
examples.zh: 老師要我們寫出自己對誠實的定義。

examples.en: The new screen has excellent picture definition.
examples.zh: 這個新螢幕的畫面清晰度非常好。

examples.en: I made a deposit at the bank this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上去銀行存了款。

examples.en: You need to pay a deposit to book the room.
examples.zh: 你需要付訂金才能預訂房間。

examples.en: The landlord returned my deposit after I moved out.
examples.zh: 房東在我搬走後退還了押金。

examples.en: She deposited her salary into a savings account.
examples.zh: 她把薪水存入儲蓄帳戶。

examples.en: Please deposit your coins in the machine.
examples.zh: 請把你的硬幣投入機器。

examples.en: He deposited the bag on the table.
examples.zh: 他把袋子放在桌上。

examples.en: The designer showed us a new set of clothes.
examples.zh: 設計師向我們展示了一套新衣服。

examples.en: My sister wants to be a web designer.
examples.zh: 我姊姊想成為網頁設計師。

examples.en: The room was decorated by a famous designer.
examples.zh: 這個房間是由一位著名的設計師佈置的。

examples.en: A quiet street is a desirable place to live.
examples.zh: 安靜的街道是理想的居住地點。

examples.en: Good computer skills are desirable for this job.
examples.zh: 具備良好的電腦技能對這份工作是有利的。

examples.en: The house has a desirable location near the station.
examples.zh: 這棟房子位置理想，就在車站附近。

examples.en: A strong typhoon can destroy many old houses.
examples.zh: 強烈颱風可能毀壞許多老房子。

examples.en: Please destroy these old files before you leave.
examples.zh: 離開前請銷毀這些舊檔案。

examples.en: Pollution can destroy the homes of sea animals.
examples.zh: 汙染會破壞海洋動物的棲息地。

examples.en: In the story, the devil asked for his soul.
examples.zh: 在故事裡，魔鬼要求他的靈魂。

examples.en: The little devil in the cartoon wore red clothes.
examples.zh: 卡通裡的小惡魔穿著紅色衣服。

examples.en: He is a lucky devil who always wins the game.
examples.zh: 他是個走運的傢伙，總是贏得比賽。

examples.en: The room was too dim for us to read.
examples.zh: 房間太昏暗，我們沒辦法閱讀。

examples.en: A dim light shone from the old window.
examples.zh: 一道微弱的光從舊窗戶透出來。

examples.en: I have only a dim memory of that trip.
examples.zh: 我對那趟旅行只有模糊的記憶。

examples.en: Please dim the lights before the movie starts.
examples.zh: 電影開始前請把燈調暗。

examples.en: The clouds dimmed the afternoon sun.
examples.zh: 雲層使午後的陽光變暗了。

examples.en: The screen will dim to save power.
examples.zh: 螢幕會變暗以節省電力。

examples.en: A dime is worth ten cents in the United States.
examples.zh: 在美國，一枚一角硬幣價值十美分。

examples.en: He found a dime on the sidewalk.
examples.zh: 他在人行道上撿到一枚一角硬幣。

examples.en: I need a dime to use the old machine.
examples.zh: 我需要一枚一角硬幣來使用這台舊機器。

examples.en: We usually dine together on Sunday evenings.
examples.zh: 我們通常在週日晚上一起用餐。

examples.en: They plan to dine at a Japanese restaurant tonight.
examples.zh: 他們打算今晚在一家日本餐廳用餐。

examples.en: Guests will dine in the garden if the weather is nice.
examples.zh: 如果天氣好，客人們會在花園裡用餐。

examples.en: I like to dip fries in ketchup.
examples.zh: 我喜歡把薯條蘸番茄醬。

examples.en: She dipped her toes in the cool water.
examples.zh: 她把腳趾浸入涼涼的水裡。

examples.en: Prices tend to dip after the holiday season.
examples.zh: 假期過後價格往往會下降。

examples.en: The party table had chips and a creamy dip.
examples.zh: 派對的桌上有洋芋片和濃稠的蘸醬。

examples.en: Let's take a quick dip in the pool.
examples.zh: 我們去泳池裡游一下吧。

examples.en: There was a small dip in sales last month.
examples.zh: 上個月銷售額略有下降。

examples.en: The children played in the dirt behind the house.
examples.zh: 孩子們在屋後的泥土裡玩耍。

examples.en: Wash the dirt off your hands before dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐前先把手上的汙垢洗掉。

examples.en: A dirt road leads to the small village.
examples.zh: 一條泥土路通往那個小村莊。

examples.en: This store gives students a ten percent discount.
examples.zh: 這家店給學生九折優惠。

examples.en: I got a big discount on the shoes.
examples.zh: 我買這雙鞋拿到很大的折扣。

examples.en: Is there a discount for buying two tickets?
examples.zh: 買兩張票有折扣嗎？

examples.en: The shop discounted all winter coats by half.
examples.zh: 商店把所有冬季外套減價一半。

examples.en: They discount old items at the end of the season.
examples.zh: 他們在季末把舊商品打折。

examples.en: Airlines often discount tickets in the off season.
examples.zh: 航空公司常在淡季為機票減價。

examples.en: Save the file on the hard disk before you shut down.
examples.zh: 關機前請把檔案存到硬碟裡。

examples.en: The disk is full, so I can't add more photos.
examples.zh: 磁碟滿了，所以我沒辦法再加照片。

examples.en: A flat disk spun slowly on the table.
examples.zh: 一個扁平的圓盤在桌上慢慢旋轉。

examples.en: Many children dislike green vegetables because they taste bitter.
examples.zh: 許多孩子不喜歡青菜，因為吃起來有苦味。

examples.en: I dislike waiting in long lines at the bank.
examples.zh: 我不喜歡在銀行排長長的隊伍。

examples.en: She dislikes loud music when she is studying.
examples.zh: 她念書的時候不喜歡吵鬧的音樂。

examples.en: He has a strong dislike of crowded places.
examples.zh: 他非常討厭擁擠的地方。

examples.en: Tell us your likes and dislikes before we order.
examples.zh: 點餐前先告訴我們你喜歡和不喜歡的東西。

examples.en: Her dislike of spicy food surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 她不愛吃辣讓大家很驚訝。

examples.en: A small ditch runs along the side of the road.
examples.zh: 路邊有一條小水溝。

examples.en: The farmer dug a ditch to carry water to his field.
examples.zh: 農夫挖了一條溝把水引到田裡。

examples.en: After the heavy rain, the ditch was full of water.
examples.zh: 大雨過後，水溝裡積滿了水。

examples.en: We decided to ditch the old plan and start again.
examples.zh: 我們決定放棄舊計畫，重新開始。

examples.en: He ditched his broken umbrella in the trash can.
examples.zh: 他把壞掉的雨傘丟進垃圾桶。

examples.en: Some students ditch class when the weather is nice.
examples.zh: 有些學生天氣好的時候會蹺課。

examples.en: The children love to dive into the pool.
examples.zh: 孩子們很愛跳進泳池。

examples.en: Tourists can dive to see colorful fish near the island.
examples.zh: 遊客可以在島附近潛水觀賞色彩繽紛的魚。

examples.en: The bird dived toward the water to catch a fish.
examples.zh: 那隻鳥朝水面俯衝去抓魚。

examples.en: His dive from the high board was perfect.
examples.zh: 他從高台跳水的動作非常完美。

examples.en: We went on a dive trip last summer.
examples.zh: 我們去年夏天去了潛水旅行。

examples.en: The plane made a sudden dive before landing.
examples.zh: 飛機在降落前突然俯衝。

examples.en: The ferry stopped at the dock at noon.
examples.zh: 渡輪中午停靠在碼頭。

examples.en: Workers unloaded boxes from the ship onto the dock.
examples.zh: 工人把箱子從船上卸到碼頭上。

examples.en: We sat on the dock and watched the sunset.
examples.zh: 我們坐在碼頭上看夕陽。

examples.en: The ship will dock in the harbor tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 這艘船明天早上會在港口靠岸。

examples.en: Several fishing boats dock here every weekend to unload their catch.
examples.zh: 每個週末都有幾艘漁船停靠在這裡卸下漁獲。

examples.en: The cruise ship docked early because of the storm.
examples.zh: 由於暴風雨，郵輪提早靠岸。

examples.en: Take one dose of the medicine after each meal.
examples.zh: 每餐飯後服用一劑藥。

examples.en: The doctor gave her a small dose to start with.
examples.zh: 醫生一開始先給她小劑量的藥。

examples.en: Do not take more than the recommended dose.
examples.zh: 不要超過建議的劑量。

examples.en: I am doubtful that the bus will arrive on time.
examples.zh: 我懷疑公車會準時抵達。

examples.en: It is doubtful whether the store is open on Sunday.
examples.zh: 這家店星期日有沒有開還很難說。

examples.en: She looked doubtful when I told her the plan.
examples.zh: 我告訴她計畫時，她看起來半信半疑。

examples.en: He had to drag the heavy suitcase up the stairs.
examples.zh: 他得把沉重的行李箱拖上樓梯。

examples.en: Please do not drag your chair across the floor.
examples.zh: 請不要把椅子在地板上拖行。

examples.en: The meeting seemed to drag on for hours.
examples.zh: 會議似乎拖了好幾個小時。

examples.en: Wind creates drag on a moving bicycle.
examples.zh: 風會對行進中的腳踏車造成阻力。

examples.en: Doing the dishes every night is such a drag.
examples.zh: 每天晚上洗碗真是件麻煩事。

examples.en: The parachute increases drag and slows the fall.
examples.zh: 降落傘增加阻力，減緩墜落速度。

examples.en: A dragonfly landed on the leaf near the pond.
examples.zh: 一隻蜻蜓停在池塘邊的葉子上。

examples.en: The dragonfly has two pairs of large, clear wings.
examples.zh: 蜻蜓有兩對又大又透明的翅膀。

examples.en: We watched a dragonfly hover over the water.
examples.zh: 我們看著一隻蜻蜓在水面上盤旋。

examples.en: Leaves blocked the drain and the street flooded.
examples.zh: 落葉堵住了排水孔，街道因而淹水。

examples.en: Please clean the kitchen drain once a week.
examples.zh: 請每週清理一次廚房的排水孔。

examples.en: Water ran down the drain after I pulled the plug.
examples.zh: 我拔掉塞子後，水就流進排水孔了。

examples.en: Drain the pasta and add the sauce.
examples.zh: 把義大利麵瀝乾，再加入醬汁。

examples.en: The workers drained the water from the pool.
examples.zh: 工人把游泳池的水排掉。

examples.en: Long meetings can drain your energy quickly.
examples.zh: 冗長的會議很快就會耗盡你的精力。

senses.zh: 戲劇性的；劇烈的；引人注目的

examples.en: The town has seen a dramatic change in the past year.
examples.zh: 這個城鎮在過去一年有了劇烈的變化。

examples.en: The movie ends with a dramatic scene on a bridge.
examples.zh: 這部電影以橋上一場戲劇性的畫面作結。

examples.en: There was a dramatic rise in prices last month.
examples.zh: 上個月物價大幅上漲。

examples.en: Water began to drip from the ceiling.
examples.zh: 水開始從天花板滴下來。

examples.en: The faucet drips all night and keeps me awake.
examples.zh: 水龍頭整晚滴水，吵得我睡不著。

examples.en: Sweat dripped down his face after the race.
examples.zh: 比賽結束後，汗水從他臉上滴下來。

examples.en: I could hear the drip of the tap in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我聽得到廚房水龍頭的滴水聲。

examples.en: A single drip fell onto the paper.
examples.zh: 一滴水落在紙上。

examples.en: The nurse checked the drip beside the bed.
examples.zh: 護理師檢查了床邊的點滴。

examples.en: Children can drown in shallow water, so adults must watch them.
examples.zh: 孩子在淺水中也可能溺水，因此大人必須看顧他們。

examples.en: Heavy rain can drown young plants by flooding their roots.
examples.zh: 大雨會淹沒幼苗的根部，可能使幼苗淹死。

examples.en: The loud music drowned out our conversation.
examples.zh: 大聲的音樂蓋過了我們的談話。

examples.en: The driver was drunk and lost his license.
examples.zh: 那位駕駛喝醉了，因此被吊銷駕照。

examples.en: Nobody should drive when they are drunk.
examples.zh: 任何人喝醉時都不該開車。

examples.en: He got drunk at the party and fell asleep.
examples.zh: 他在派對上喝醉，然後睡著了。

examples.en: Please do not dump trash in the river.
examples.zh: 請不要把垃圾倒進河裡。

examples.en: He dumped his bag on the sofa and sat down.
examples.zh: 他把袋子往沙發上一扔就坐下了。

examples.en: The truck dumped sand at the building site.
examples.zh: 卡車把沙子倒在工地上。

examples.en: The old factory was turned into a rubbish dump.
examples.zh: 那座舊工廠被改成垃圾場。

examples.en: His room is a dump, so please clean it.
examples.zh: 他的房間亂得像垃圾堆，請把它整理乾淨。

examples.en: We took the broken chairs to the dump.
examples.zh: 我們把壞掉的椅子送到垃圾場。

examples.en: A thick layer of dust covered the old books.
examples.zh: 一層厚厚的灰塵覆蓋著那些舊書。

examples.en: The wind blew dust into my eyes.
examples.zh: 風把灰塵吹進了我的眼睛。

examples.en: She wiped the dust off the table.
examples.zh: 她把桌上的灰塵擦掉。

examples.en: I dust the shelves every Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 我每個星期六早上都會擦書架上的灰塵。

examples.en: Please dust the furniture before the guests arrive.
examples.zh: 請在客人抵達前把家具撢乾淨。

examples.en: She dusted the chocolate cake with sugar before serving it.
examples.zh: 她在端出巧克力蛋糕前，先在上面撒了糖粉。

examples.en: The students are eager to start the school trip.
examples.zh: 學生們迫不及待想開始校外教學。

examples.en: She is eager to learn how to cook.
examples.zh: 她渴望學會做菜。

examples.en: The eager fans waited outside the stadium.
examples.zh: 熱切的粉絲在體育場外等待。

examples.en: We heard an echo when we shouted in the cave.
examples.zh: 我們在山洞裡大喊時聽到了回音。

examples.en: Every shout produced an echo in the empty hall.
examples.zh: 每一聲喊叫都在空蕩蕩的大廳裡產生回音。

examples.en: The echo of her voice faded slowly.
examples.zh: 她聲音的回音慢慢消失了。

examples.en: Their voices echoed across the valley as they called for help.
examples.zh: 他們呼救時，聲音在山谷裡迴盪。

examples.en: The big hall echoes when it is empty.
examples.zh: 這間大廳空著的時候會有回音。

examples.en: Her words echoed in my mind all day.
examples.zh: 她的話整天在我腦海裡迴響。

examples.en: Please edit your essay before you hand it in.
examples.zh: 交作業前請先修改你的作文。

examples.en: She likes to edit videos on her laptop.
examples.zh: 她喜歡用筆記型電腦剪輯影片。

examples.en: The teacher helped us edit the school newspaper.
examples.zh: 老師幫我們編輯校刊。

examples.en: The editor changed the title of the article.
examples.zh: 編輯更改了這篇文章的標題。

examples.en: She works as an editor at a publishing company.
examples.zh: 她在一家出版社擔任編輯。

examples.en: Open the photo in an editor and crop it.
examples.zh: 用編輯軟體開啟這張照片，然後裁切它。

examples.en: Schools educate children and prepare them for the future.
examples.zh: 學校教育孩子，並為他們的未來做準備。

examples.en: Parents should educate their kids about road safety.
examples.zh: 父母應該教導孩子交通安全。

examples.en: The poster aims to educate people about recycling.
examples.zh: 這張海報的目的是讓大家認識資源回收。

examples.en: This museum offers educational programs for students.
examples.zh: 這間博物館為學生提供教育活動。

examples.en: The trip to the science museum was both fun and educational.
examples.zh: 這趟科學博物館之旅既有趣又有教育意義。

examples.en: He watches educational videos to learn English.
examples.zh: 他看教育影片來學英文。

examples.en: The new machine is faster and more efficient.
examples.zh: 新機器更快，也更有效率。

examples.en: She is an efficient worker who finishes tasks early.
examples.zh: 她是個很有效率的員工，總是提早完成工作。

examples.en: LED lights are more energy efficient than old bulbs.
examples.zh: LED 燈比舊燈泡更省能源。

examples.en: He hurt his elbow when he fell off the bike.
examples.zh: 他從腳踏車上摔下來時傷到了手肘。

examples.en: Please do not put your elbows on the table.
examples.zh: 請不要把手肘放在桌上。

examples.en: The plumber replaced the elbow in the water pipe.
examples.zh: 水電工換掉了水管的彎頭。

examples.en: He elbowed his way through the crowd.
examples.zh: 他用手肘擠過人群。

examples.en: She elbowed me gently to get my attention.
examples.zh: 她用手肘輕輕碰我，想引起我的注意。

examples.en: Don't elbow others on the crowded train.
examples.zh: 在擁擠的火車上不要用手肘推別人。

examples.en: An elderly man gave directions to the tourists.
examples.zh: 一位年長的男士為遊客指路。

examples.en: Please give your seat to elderly passengers.
examples.zh: 請把座位讓給年長的乘客。

examples.en: My elderly neighbor walks in the park every morning.
examples.zh: 我那位年長的鄰居每天早上都在公園散步。

examples.en: The government offers free health checks for the elderly.
examples.zh: 政府提供老年人免費健康檢查。

examples.en: Volunteers visit the elderly once a week.
examples.zh: 志工每週拜訪老年人一次。

examples.en: The elderly often need extra help with technology.
examples.zh: 老年人在使用科技產品時常常需要額外協助。

examples.en: The storm cut off the electricity in our town.
examples.zh: 暴風雨切斷了我們鎮上的電力。

examples.en: Solar panels can produce electricity from sunlight.
examples.zh: 太陽能板可以利用陽光發電。

examples.en: We try to save electricity by turning off the lights.
examples.zh: 我們盡量關燈來節約用電。

examples.en: This store sells electronic devices and cameras.
examples.zh: 這家店販售電子產品和相機。

examples.en: You can send an electronic form to the office.
examples.zh: 你可以把電子表格寄到辦公室。

examples.en: Many students use electronic dictionaries to look up new words.
examples.zh: 許多學生使用電子辭典查詢生字。

examples.en: The elevator is out of order, so we took the stairs.
examples.zh: 電梯故障了，所以我們走樓梯。

examples.en: Press the button to call the elevator.
examples.zh: 按下按鈕叫電梯。

examples.en: We met our manager in the elevator this morning.
examples.zh: 我們今天早上在電梯裡遇到了經理。

examples.en: Call this number in case of an emergency.
examples.zh: 遇到緊急情況請撥打這個號碼。

examples.en: The hospital has an emergency room open all night.
examples.zh: 這家醫院的急診室整晚開放。

examples.en: Keep a flashlight at home for emergencies.
examples.zh: 家裡要備一支手電筒以備不時之需。

examples.en: The pilot made an emergency landing at the airport.
examples.zh: 機師在機場緊急降落。

examples.en: There is an emergency exit at the back of the room.
examples.zh: 房間後方有一個緊急出口。

examples.en: The school held an emergency meeting last night.
examples.zh: 學校昨晚召開了緊急會議。

senses.zh: 情感的；情緒激動的；感人的

examples.en: She felt emotional when she said goodbye to her friends.
examples.zh: 她向朋友道別時情緒很激動。

examples.en: The movie has a very emotional ending.
examples.zh: 這部電影的結局非常感人。

examples.en: Children need emotional support from their families.
examples.zh: 孩子需要家人的情感支持。

examples.en: The emperor lived in a huge palace.
examples.zh: 皇帝住在一座巨大的宮殿裡。

examples.en: Our history teacher talked about the first emperor of China.
examples.zh: 我們的歷史老師談到中國的第一位皇帝。

examples.en: The emperor ruled the country for many years.
examples.zh: 這位皇帝統治這個國家多年。

examples.en: A good teacher knows how to engage students in class.
examples.zh: 好老師懂得如何讓學生投入課堂。

examples.en: The company wants to engage more young customers.
examples.zh: 這家公司想吸引更多年輕顧客。

examples.en: He is engaged in a project about solar energy.
examples.zh: 他正在從事一項太陽能專案。

examples.en: We had an enjoyable evening at the concert.
examples.zh: 我們在音樂會度過了愉快的夜晚。

examples.en: The class was enjoyable and not too difficult.
examples.zh: 這堂課很有趣，而且不會太難。

examples.en: Reading by the window is an enjoyable way to relax.
examples.zh: 在窗邊閱讀是一種愉快的放鬆方式。

examples.en: Entry to the museum is free for students.
examples.zh: 學生進入博物館是免費的。

examples.en: Please use the side entry after six o'clock.
examples.zh: 六點以後請使用側門入口。

examples.en: Her entry won first prize in the contest.
examples.zh: 她的參賽作品在比賽中獲得第一名。

examples.en: Please erase the board before the next class.
examples.zh: 請在下一堂課前把黑板擦乾淨。

examples.en: He erased the wrong answer and wrote a new one.
examples.zh: 他擦掉錯誤的答案，寫上新的。

examples.en: Don't erase the files until you save a copy.
examples.zh: 在你存好備份之前，不要刪除這些檔案。

examples.en: The school is known for its academic excellence.
examples.zh: 這所學校以學術卓越聞名。

examples.en: She won an award for excellence in teaching.
examples.zh: 她因教學卓越而獲獎。

examples.en: Our company aims for excellence in customer service.
examples.zh: 我們公司以卓越的客戶服務為目標。

examples.en: The two classes exchange letters every month.
examples.zh: 這兩個班級每個月互相交換信件。

examples.en: I want to exchange this shirt for a larger size.
examples.zh: 我想把這件襯衫換成大一點的尺寸。

examples.en: You can exchange dollars for local money at the airport.
examples.zh: 你可以在機場把美元換成當地貨幣。

examples.en: The school runs a student exchange program with Japan.
examples.zh: 學校與日本辦有學生交換計畫。

examples.en: We had a friendly exchange of ideas in class.
examples.zh: 我們在課堂上友善地交流了想法。

examples.en: The exchange rate changes daily, so check it before buying foreign currency.
examples.zh: 匯率每天都在變動，因此購買外幣前要先確認匯率。

examples.en: The art exhibition opens next Monday at the city museum.
examples.zh: 這場藝術展下週一在市立博物館開幕。

examples.en: We visited a science exhibition during the school trip.
examples.zh: 校外教學時我們參觀了一場科學展。

examples.en: The photo exhibition attracted hundreds of visitors.
examples.zh: 這場攝影展吸引了數百名參觀者。

examples.en: The hotel exceeded our expectations with its clean rooms and friendly staff.
examples.zh: 這間飯店乾淨的客房和親切的員工讓我們的體驗超出預期。

examples.en: Her parents have high expectations for her grades.
examples.zh: 她的父母對她的成績期望很高。

examples.en: There is no expectation that you will work overtime.
examples.zh: 沒有人預期你要加班。

examples.en: We did an experiment in science class on Monday.
examples.zh: 我們星期一在自然課做了一個實驗。

examples.en: The experiment showed that plants need sunlight.
examples.zh: 這項實驗顯示植物需要陽光。

examples.en: She wrote a report about her experiment.
examples.zh: 她寫了一份關於她實驗的報告。

examples.en: Scientists experiment with new materials to make safer bicycle helmets.
examples.zh: 科學家用新材料做實驗，以製作更安全的自行車安全帽。

examples.en: I like to experiment with different recipes.
examples.zh: 我喜歡嘗試不同的食譜。

examples.en: The company is experimenting with a four-day work week.
examples.zh: 這家公司正在試行一週工作四天。

examples.en: The balloon exploded with a loud pop.
examples.zh: 氣球啪的一聲爆開了。

examples.en: Sales exploded after the new phone came out.
examples.zh: 新手機問世後，銷量暴增。

examples.en: Fireworks exploded above the river last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚煙火在河面上空綻放。

examples.en: We want to explore the old town on foot.
examples.zh: 我們想徒步探索這座老城。

examples.en: Scientists explore the deep sea with small submarines.
examples.zh: 科學家用小型潛水艇探索深海。

examples.en: The class will explore this topic in more detail.
examples.zh: 這堂課會更深入地探討這個主題。

examples.en: Extreme heat made it hard to work outside.
examples.zh: 極度的高溫讓人很難在戶外工作。

examples.en: She takes extreme care when she carries glass.
examples.zh: 她搬玻璃時格外小心。

examples.en: The team holds extreme views on this issue.
examples.zh: 這個團隊對此議題抱持極端的看法。

examples.en: The weather here goes from one extreme to another.
examples.zh: 這裡的天氣從一個極端變到另一個極端。

examples.en: Going to extremes is not good for your health.
examples.zh: 走極端對健康不好。

examples.en: Summers are hot, and winters are cold in the extreme.
examples.zh: 這裡夏天炎熱，冬天則冷到極點。

examples.en: The color of my jeans began to fade.
examples.zh: 我牛仔褲的顏色開始褪了。

examples.en: The music faded as we walked away from the stage.
examples.zh: 我們走離舞台時，音樂聲漸漸變小。

examples.en: Her smile faded when she heard the news.
examples.zh: 她聽到消息時，笑容漸漸消失。

examples.en: I heard a faint sound from the next room.
examples.zh: 我聽到隔壁房間傳來微弱的聲音。

examples.en: There was a faint smell of coffee in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 廚房裡有淡淡的咖啡香。

examples.en: The writing on the old sign is too faint to read.
examples.zh: 那塊舊招牌上的字太模糊，看不清楚。

examples.en: She felt dizzy and nearly fainted after skipping breakfast.
examples.zh: 她沒吃早餐，覺得頭暈，差點昏倒。

examples.en: Several people fainted in the hot hall.
examples.zh: 好幾個人在悶熱的大廳裡昏倒了。

examples.en: He fainted after standing in the sun for hours.
examples.zh: 他在太陽下站了好幾個小時後昏倒了。

examples.en: The test was fairly easy for most students.
examples.zh: 這次考試對大部分學生來說相當簡單。

examples.en: The teacher treats all students fairly and listens to their concerns.
examples.zh: 老師公平對待所有學生，也會聆聽他們的疑慮。

examples.en: It is a fairly small town near the coast.
examples.zh: 這是個靠海的相當小的城鎮。

examples.en: The little girl dressed up as a fairy for the party.
examples.zh: 小女孩打扮成仙女去參加派對。

examples.en: In the story, a fairy helps the poor farmer.
examples.zh: 故事裡，一位仙女幫助了貧窮的農夫。

examples.en: My sister loves reading fairy tales before bed.
examples.zh: 我妹妹喜歡睡前讀童話故事。

examples.en: I have great faith in my team.
examples.zh: 我對我的團隊很有信心。

examples.en: Faith helped her through the difficult year.
examples.zh: 信念幫助她度過了艱難的一年。

examples.en: Many people go to the temple to practice their faith.
examples.zh: 許多人到廟裡實踐自己的信仰。

examples.en: This bag looks nice, but it is fake.
examples.zh: 這個包包看起來不錯，但是是假貨。

examples.en: Be careful of fake websites when you shop online.
examples.zh: 網路購物時要小心假網站。

examples.en: He gave a fake smile to the guests.
examples.zh: 他對客人露出了假笑。

examples.en: The painting turned out to be a fake.
examples.zh: 這幅畫結果是贗品。

examples.en: The police found many fakes at the market.
examples.zh: 警方在市場上查獲許多假貨。

examples.en: That watch is a fake, not the real thing.
examples.zh: 那支手錶是假貨，不是真品。

examples.en: The song sounded familiar, but I could not remember its title.
examples.zh: 這首歌聽起來很耳熟，但我想不起歌名。

examples.en: Are you familiar with this software for editing photos?
examples.zh: 你熟悉這款用來編輯照片的軟體嗎？

examples.en: It was nice to see a familiar face in the crowd.
examples.zh: 在人群中看到熟悉的面孔真好。

examples.en: The bus fare to the city center is thirty dollars.
examples.zh: 搭公車到市中心的車資是三十元。

examples.en: Children pay a lower fare on the train.
examples.zh: 小孩搭火車付的票價比較低。

examples.en: The taxi fare to the airport was higher than I expected.
examples.zh: 到機場的計程車車資比我預期的高。

examples.en: How did you fare in the exam?
examples.zh: 你考試考得如何？

examples.en: Small shops fared badly during the holiday.
examples.zh: 小商店在假期期間生意不好。

examples.en: The team fared well in the final round.
examples.zh: 這支隊伍在決賽中表現不錯。

examples.en: A colorful feather fell from the bird's wing.
examples.zh: 一根彩色的羽毛從鳥的翅膀上掉下來。

examples.en: She decorated her hat with a long feather.
examples.zh: 她用一根長長的羽毛裝飾帽子。

examples.en: The pillow is filled with soft feathers from ducks.
examples.zh: 這個枕頭裡填滿了柔軟的鴨毛。

examples.en: The young fighter trained hard every morning before school.
examples.zh: 這位年輕的選手每天早上上學前都努力訓練。

examples.en: She is a fighter who never gives up on her dreams.
examples.zh: 她是個永不放棄夢想的奮鬥者。

examples.en: Two fighter jets flew over the stadium during the ceremony.
examples.zh: 典禮期間有兩架戰鬥機飛越體育場上空。

examples.en: We watched the fireworks from the roof of the hotel.
examples.zh: 我們從飯店的屋頂觀賞煙火。

examples.en: The children were excited about the fireworks at the festival.
examples.zh: 孩子們對慶典上的煙火感到很興奮。

examples.en: The city holds a large fireworks display on New Year's Eve.
examples.zh: 這座城市在跨年夜舉辦盛大的煙火表演。

examples.en: He held the coin tightly in his fist.
examples.zh: 他把硬幣緊緊握在拳頭裡。

examples.en: The baby opened and closed her tiny fist.
examples.zh: 寶寶把她小小的拳頭張開又握緊。

examples.en: The teacher raised a fist to show strong support.
examples.zh: 老師舉起拳頭表達強力的支持。

examples.en: The candle flame moved gently in the breeze.
examples.zh: 燭火在微風中輕輕搖曳。

examples.en: Firefighters rushed to put out the flames in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 消防員衝去撲滅廚房裡的火焰。

examples.en: Please turn down the flame so the soup does not burn.
examples.zh: 請把火關小一點，湯才不會燒焦。

examples.en: The dry wood flamed brightly in the fireplace.
examples.zh: 乾木頭在壁爐裡燒得很旺。

examples.en: Her face flamed with embarrassment when she forgot her lines.
examples.zh: 她忘詞時，臉羞得通紅。

examples.en: The sky flamed orange as the sun went down.
examples.zh: 太陽下山時，天空染成一片橘紅。

examples.en: A flash of lightning lit up the whole street.
examples.zh: 一道閃電照亮了整條街。

examples.en: Turn off the flash when you take photos in the museum.
examples.zh: 在博物館拍照時請關掉閃光燈。

examples.en: The news spread across the school in a flash.
examples.zh: 這個消息一瞬間就傳遍了學校。

examples.en: The warning light flashed red on the dashboard.
examples.zh: 儀表板上的警示燈閃著紅光。

examples.en: A smile flashed across her face when she saw us.
examples.zh: 她看到我們時，臉上閃過一抹微笑。

examples.en: The train flashed past the station without stopping.
examples.zh: 火車沒有停靠，呼嘯著駛過車站。

examples.en: This ice cream comes in twelve different flavors.
examples.zh: 這種冰淇淋有十二種不同的口味。

examples.en: Fresh herbs add a lot of flavor to the soup.
examples.zh: 新鮮香草為這道湯增添了許多風味。

examples.en: The tea served at this restaurant has a rich, distinctive flavor.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳供應的茶具有濃郁而獨特的風味。

examples.en: She flavored the cake with lemon and vanilla.
examples.zh: 她用檸檬和香草為蛋糕調味。

examples.en: Mom flavors the rice with a little ginger.
examples.zh: 媽媽用一點薑為米飯調味。

examples.en: You can flavor the tea with honey if you like.
examples.zh: 如果你喜歡，可以用蜂蜜為茶調味。

examples.en: The flesh of this fish is soft and white.
examples.zh: 這種魚的肉質柔軟潔白。

examples.en: Cut the fruit open and scoop out the sweet flesh.
examples.zh: 把水果切開，舀出甜甜的果肉。

examples.en: The doctor checked the flesh around the wound.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查了傷口周圍的皮肉。

examples.en: Small boats float on the calm lake.
examples.zh: 小船漂浮在平靜的湖面上。

examples.en: A balloon floated up into the sky.
examples.zh: 一顆氣球飄上了天空。

examples.en: Wood can float because it is lighter than water.
examples.zh: 木頭比水輕，所以能浮在水上。

examples.en: The fisherman watched his float move on the water.
examples.zh: 漁夫看著他的浮標在水面上移動。

examples.en: Each class built a colorful float for the parade.
examples.zh: 每個班級都為遊行做了一輛彩色花車。

examples.en: Beginners hold a float to support themselves while learning to swim.
examples.zh: 初學者學游泳時會拿著浮板支撐身體。

examples.en: A flock of birds flew over the field.
examples.zh: 一群鳥飛過田野。

examples.en: The shepherd leads his flock up the hill every morning.
examples.zh: 牧羊人每天早上帶著羊群上山。

examples.en: We saw a large flock of geese by the river.
examples.zh: 我們在河邊看到一大群鵝。

examples.en: Tourists flock to the beach in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天遊客成群湧向海灘。

examples.en: Fans flocked to the shop to buy the new album.
examples.zh: 粉絲們湧進店裡買新專輯。

examples.en: People flock to the night market on weekends.
examples.zh: 週末人們都湧向夜市。

examples.en: The heavy rain caused a flood in the small town.
examples.zh: 大雨在小鎮造成了水災。

examples.en: Many families lost their homes in the flood.
examples.zh: 許多家庭在洪水中失去了家園。

examples.en: The government built walls to protect the village from floods.
examples.zh: 政府築起圍牆保護村莊免受洪水侵襲。

examples.en: The river flooded the streets last night.
examples.zh: 河水昨晚淹沒了街道。

examples.en: Letters of thanks flooded the school office.
examples.zh: 感謝信如潮水般湧入學校辦公室。

examples.en: The bathroom flooded because the pipe broke.
examples.zh: 水管破裂，浴室淹水了。

examples.en: Please fold the letter and put it in the envelope.
examples.zh: 請把信摺好放進信封。

examples.en: She folded her arms and waited for an answer.
examples.zh: 她雙手交叉在胸前，等待答覆。

examples.en: He folded the map and slipped it into his bag.
examples.zh: 他把地圖摺起來，塞進包包裡。

examples.en: There is a deep fold in the middle of the paper.
examples.zh: 這張紙中間有一道很深的摺痕。

examples.en: The cat slept in the fold of the blanket.
examples.zh: 貓睡在毯子的摺層裡。

examples.en: Iron the shirt carefully along each fold.
examples.zh: 沿著每一道摺痕小心地熨燙襯衫。

examples.en: The singer has millions of followers online.
examples.zh: 這位歌手在網路上有數百萬名粉絲。

examples.en: She is a loyal follower of the local baseball team.
examples.zh: 她是當地棒球隊的忠實球迷。

examples.en: The leader thanked every follower for the support.
examples.zh: 領袖感謝每一位追隨者的支持。

examples.en: My little brother is fond of dinosaurs.
examples.zh: 我弟弟很喜歡恐龍。

examples.en: She has fond memories of her grandmother's kitchen.
examples.zh: 她對外婆的廚房有著溫馨的回憶。

examples.en: The teacher is very fond of her students.
examples.zh: 老師非常疼愛她的學生。

examples.en: I will remember this trip with my family forever.
examples.zh: 我會永遠記得這趟與家人一起的旅行。

examples.en: The old bridge will not last forever.
examples.zh: 這座老橋不可能永遠撐下去。

examples.en: They promised to stay friends forever after finishing high school.
examples.zh: 他們承諾高中畢業後也要永遠做朋友。

examples.en: He made a fortune by selling used books online.
examples.zh: 他在網路上賣二手書賺了一大筆錢。

examples.en: We had the good fortune to meet a kind guide.
examples.zh: 我們很幸運遇到一位親切的導遊。

examples.en: She went to the temple to have her fortune told.
examples.zh: 她去廟裡算命。

examples.en: Children played near the fountain in the park.
examples.zh: 孩子們在公園的噴泉旁玩耍。

examples.en: We took photos in front of the beautiful fountain.
examples.zh: 我們在美麗的噴泉前拍照。

examples.en: The fountain stops running at ten o'clock at night.
examples.zh: 噴泉在晚上十點就會停止噴水。

examples.en: Water freezes at zero degrees Celsius under normal atmospheric pressure.
examples.zh: 在正常大氣壓力下，水會在攝氏零度結冰。

examples.en: You can freeze the extra soup for next week.
examples.zh: 你可以把多的湯冷凍起來留到下週。

examples.en: We almost froze while waiting for the bus.
examples.zh: 我們等公車時差點被凍僵。

examples.en: A hard freeze last night damaged the vegetables.
examples.zh: 昨晚的嚴寒凍傷了蔬菜。

examples.en: The company announced a freeze on new hiring.
examples.zh: 公司宣布凍結招募新人。

examples.en: There was a deep freeze across the northern cities.
examples.zh: 北方城市出現了一波嚴寒。

examples.en: He is a frequent visitor to the school library.
examples.zh: 他是學校圖書館的常客。

examples.en: Frequent rain made our walking tour of the island difficult.
examples.zh: 頻繁的降雨讓我們徒步遊覽這座島嶼時困難重重。

examples.en: There are frequent buses between the two cities.
examples.zh: 兩個城市之間的公車班次很密集。

examples.en: Many students frequent the bookstore near the school.
examples.zh: 許多學生常去學校附近的書店。

examples.en: She frequents that cafe on weekends to read and relax.
examples.zh: 她週末常去那家咖啡廳閱讀、放鬆。

examples.en: Tourists frequent this beach in summer because the water is clear.
examples.zh: 夏天遊客常到這片海灘，因為那裡的海水清澈。

examples.en: The loud noise gave me a terrible fright.
examples.zh: 那聲巨響把我嚇了一大跳。

examples.en: The little girl cried out in fright.
examples.zh: 小女孩驚嚇得大叫起來。

examples.en: He recovered from the fright after a cup of tea.
examples.zh: 他喝了杯茶後就從驚嚇中恢復了。

examples.en: The car stopped because it ran out of fuel.
examples.zh: 車子因為沒油而停了下來。

examples.en: Fuel prices rose again this month, increasing costs for drivers.
examples.zh: 這個月燃料價格又上漲了，增加了駕駛人的開銷。

examples.en: Wood is still used as fuel in some villages.
examples.zh: 有些村莊仍然用木柴當燃料。

examples.en: Workers fueled the plane before takeoff while passengers waited inside the terminal.
examples.zh: 工作人員在起飛前為飛機加油，乘客則在航廈內等候。

examples.en: Rumors fueled the fear among the students.
examples.zh: 謠言助長了學生之間的恐慌。

examples.en: A good breakfast will fuel you for the whole morning.
examples.zh: 一頓豐盛的早餐能讓你一整個早上充滿活力。

examples.en: The school set up a fund to help poor students.
examples.zh: 學校設立了一筆基金來幫助清寒學生。

examples.en: We need more funds to finish the project.
examples.zh: 我們需要更多資金來完成這個專案。

examples.en: She donated money to the relief fund.
examples.zh: 她捐錢給救災基金。

examples.en: The government will fund the new library.
examples.zh: 政府將出資興建新圖書館。

examples.en: Local businesses funded the school trip to the science museum.
examples.zh: 當地商家資助了這次前往科學博物館的校外旅行。

examples.en: The research was funded by a large company.
examples.zh: 這項研究由一家大公司出資。

examples.en: The cat has soft white fur and bright green eyes.
examples.zh: 這隻貓有柔軟的白色皮毛和明亮的綠眼睛。

examples.en: Her winter coat has a fur collar to keep her neck warm.
examples.zh: 她的冬季外套有毛皮領子，能讓頸部保暖。

examples.en: Brush the dog's fur every day to keep it clean.
examples.zh: 每天幫狗梳毛，讓牠保持乾淨。

examples.en: We bought a gallon of milk at the supermarket.
examples.zh: 我們在超市買了一加侖的牛奶。

examples.en: The tank holds about ten gallons of water.
examples.zh: 這個水槽大約能裝十加侖的水。

examples.en: A gallon of paint is enough for two rooms.
examples.zh: 一加侖的油漆足夠粉刷兩個房間。

examples.en: He lost his savings when he gambled at the casino.
examples.zh: 他在賭場賭博輸光了積蓄。

examples.en: The company gambled on a new product and won.
examples.zh: 公司在一項新產品上冒險一搏，結果成功了。

examples.en: You should not gamble with your future.
examples.zh: 你不該拿自己的未來冒險。

examples.zh: 創業總是一場冒險。

examples.en: The coach's gamble paid off in the final game.
examples.zh: 教練的冒險在決賽中得到了回報。

examples.en: Moving to a new city was a big gamble for them.
examples.zh: 搬到新城市對他們來說是一大賭注。

examples.en: The police arrested members of a gang last night.
examples.zh: 警方昨晚逮捕了幫派成員。

examples.en: A gang of kids played ball in the street.
examples.zh: 一群孩子在街上玩球。

examples.en: My old gang from school meets every summer.
examples.zh: 我學生時代的那群朋友每年夏天都會聚會。

examples.en: The cat slipped through a gap in the fence.
examples.zh: 貓從籬笆的縫隙鑽了過去。

examples.en: There is a big gap between the rich and the poor.
examples.zh: 貧富之間有很大的差距。

examples.en: I need to fill the gap in my resume.
examples.zh: 我必須補上履歷中的空白。

examples.zh: 她匆匆看了一眼手錶。

examples.en: At first glance, the room looked clean.
examples.zh: 乍看之下，房間很乾淨。

examples.en: He gave me a glance and walked away.
examples.zh: 他瞥了我一眼就走開了。

examples.en: He glanced at the clock during the meeting.
examples.zh: 他在會議中瞥了一眼時鐘。

examples.zh: 她瞥向窗外，看到下雨了。

examples.en: I only glanced through the newspaper this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上只是大略翻了翻報紙。

examples.en: Global warming is a serious problem that affects every country.
examples.zh: 全球暖化是影響每個國家的嚴重問題。

examples.en: The company has a global network of stores.
examples.zh: 這家公司在全球各地都有分店。

examples.en: The movie became a global success and attracted millions of viewers.
examples.zh: 這部電影在全球大受歡迎，吸引了數百萬名觀眾。

examples.en: The team returned home covered in glory.
examples.zh: 球隊榮耀滿身地回到家鄉。

examples.en: Everyone admired the glory of the sunrise.
examples.zh: 大家都讚嘆日出的壯麗。

examples.en: She worked hard for the glory of her school.
examples.zh: 她為了學校的榮譽努力不懈。

examples.en: The lamp glowed softly in the dark room.
examples.zh: 燈在昏暗的房間裡散發著柔和的光。

examples.en: Her cheeks glowed after she ran up the hill.
examples.zh: 她跑上山後，雙頰紅通通的。

examples.en: The little girl glowed with pride at the ceremony.
examples.zh: 小女孩在典禮上驕傲得容光煥發。

examples.en: The glow of the candle filled the room.
examples.zh: 燭光灑滿了整個房間。

examples.en: We saw a warm glow in the window.
examples.zh: 我們看見窗戶透出溫暖的光亮。

examples.en: A healthy glow came back to his face.
examples.zh: 他的臉上恢復了健康的紅潤。

examples.en: I do not like to listen to gossip at work.
examples.zh: 我不喜歡在工作時聽八卦。

examples.en: The magazine is full of gossip about movie stars.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌滿是電影明星的八卦。

examples.en: Don't believe the gossip you hear in the hallway.
examples.zh: 別相信你在走廊上聽到的閒話。

examples.en: They gossiped about their classmates after school.
examples.zh: 他們放學後聊起同學的八卦。

examples.en: Please don't gossip about your coworkers or spread rumors about them.
examples.zh: 請不要議論同事的私事，也不要散播關於他們的謠言。

examples.en: The neighbors gossip every time she comes home late.
examples.zh: 每次她晚歸，鄰居們就會議論紛紛。

examples.en: The governor spoke to reporters outside the building.
examples.zh: 州長在大樓外向記者發言。

examples.en: The governor of the state visited our school.
examples.zh: 州長來我們學校參訪。

examples.en: People voted for a new governor last Tuesday.
examples.zh: 人們上週二投票選出新任州長。

examples.en: He grabbed his umbrella and ran out the door.
examples.zh: 他抓起雨傘就衝出門去。

examples.en: Let's grab a quick lunch before the meeting.
examples.zh: 開會前我們隨便吃個午餐吧。

examples.en: She grabbed my arm to stop me from falling.
examples.zh: 她抓住我的手臂，讓我不會跌倒。

examples.en: The baby made a grab for the toy.
examples.zh: 寶寶伸手去抓那個玩具。

examples.en: With a quick grab, he caught the falling cup.
examples.zh: 他迅速一抓，接住了掉落的杯子。

examples.en: The bag was easy to reach, so I made a grab for it.
examples.zh: 那個袋子很容易拿到，我就伸手一抓。

examples.en: She will graduate from university next June.
examples.zh: 她明年六月將從大學畢業。

examples.en: My brother graduated from high school last year.
examples.zh: 我哥哥去年從高中畢業。

examples.en: Most university students graduate at the age of twenty-two.
examples.zh: 大部分大學生在二十二歲時畢業。

examples.en: He is a graduate of National Taiwan University.
examples.zh: 他是國立臺灣大學的畢業生。

examples.en: The company hires many fresh graduates each year.
examples.zh: 這家公司每年都會雇用許多應屆畢業生。

examples.en: The graduates threw their caps into the air.
examples.zh: 畢業生們把帽子拋向空中。

examples.en: The baby grasped my finger with her tiny hand.
examples.zh: 寶寶用小手抓住我的手指。

examples.en: He quickly grasped the main idea of the lesson.
examples.zh: 他很快就理解了這堂課的重點。

examples.en: She grasped the rope and pulled herself up.
examples.zh: 她抓緊繩子把自己拉上去。

examples.en: He has a good grasp of English grammar.
examples.zh: 他對英文文法有很好的掌握。

examples.en: The ball slipped out of my grasp.
examples.zh: 球從我的手中滑掉了。

examples.en: The explanation is beyond my grasp because it uses unfamiliar terms.
examples.zh: 這段解釋超出了我的理解範圍，因為其中使用了我不熟悉的術語。

examples.en: The farmer grows tomatoes in a greenhouse.
examples.zh: 農夫在溫室裡種番茄。

examples.en: It is always warm inside the greenhouse.
examples.zh: 溫室裡面總是很溫暖。

examples.en: We visited a greenhouse full of tropical flowers.
examples.zh: 我們參觀了一座種滿熱帶花卉的溫室。

examples.en: He had a big grin on his face.
examples.zh: 他臉上露出大大的笑容。

examples.en: She gave me a quick grin and waved.
examples.zh: 她對我咧嘴一笑並揮了揮手。

examples.en: A proud grin spread across the boy's face.
examples.zh: 男孩臉上浮現出得意的笑容。

examples.en: The kids grinned when they saw the cake.
examples.zh: 孩子們看到蛋糕就咧嘴笑了。

examples.en: He grinned at me from across the room.
examples.zh: 他從房間另一頭對我咧嘴而笑。

examples.en: She grinned happily after winning the prize.
examples.zh: 她得獎後開心地笑了。

examples.en: Mom does the grocery shopping every Saturday.
examples.zh: 媽媽每週六都會去採買食品雜貨。

examples.en: The grocery on the corner closes at ten.
examples.zh: 轉角的雜貨店十點關門。

examples.en: I put the groceries in the refrigerator.
examples.zh: 我把採買的食物放進冰箱。

examples.en: The students need guidance from their teachers.
examples.zh: 學生需要老師的指導。

examples.en: She offers career guidance to young people.
examples.zh: 她為年輕人提供職涯指導。

examples.en: With your guidance, I finished the project.
examples.zh: 在你的指導下，我完成了這個專案。

examples.en: Please do not chew gum in class.
examples.zh: 請不要在課堂上嚼口香糖。

examples.en: My gums hurt after I brushed too hard.
examples.zh: 我刷牙太用力，之後牙齦就痛了。

examples.en: He stuck a piece of gum under the desk.
examples.zh: 他把一塊口香糖黏在桌子下面。

examples.en: My hairdresser cut my hair very short.
examples.zh: 我的美髮師把我的頭髮剪得很短。

examples.en: She works as a hairdresser in a small salon.
examples.zh: 她在一家小沙龍當美髮師。

examples.en: I have an appointment with the hairdresser at three.
examples.zh: 我跟美髮師約了三點。

examples.en: Students walked quietly down the hallway while other classes were taking tests.
examples.zh: 其他班級正在考試時，學生們安靜地走過走廊。

examples.en: Leave your shoes in the hallway, please.
examples.zh: 請把鞋子放在玄關。

examples.en: The hallway was dark, so I turned on the light.
examples.zh: 走廊很暗，所以我打開了燈。

examples.en: She picked up a handful of nuts from the bowl.
examples.zh: 她從碗裡抓了一把堅果。

examples.en: Only a handful of students came to the meeting.
examples.zh: 只有少數學生來參加會議。

examples.en: He tossed a handful of rice into the pot.
examples.zh: 他把一把米丟進鍋裡。

examples.en: A small flashlight is handy when the power goes out.
examples.zh: 停電時，小手電筒很方便。

examples.en: Keep your phone handy in case I call.
examples.zh: 把手機放在手邊，以防我打電話給你。

examples.en: My father is handy with tools and repairs our furniture himself.
examples.zh: 我爸爸擅長使用工具，會自己修理家裡的家具。

examples.en: Many boats were waiting in the harbor.
examples.zh: 許多船停在港口等待。

examples.en: We had seafood by the harbor last night.
examples.zh: 我們昨晚在港邊吃海鮮。

examples.en: The ship entered the harbor at dawn.
examples.zh: 這艘船在黎明時進入港口。

examples.en: She harbored a hope of becoming a doctor.
examples.zh: 她心懷成為醫生的希望。

examples.en: He still harbors a grudge against his old friend.
examples.zh: 他仍對老朋友懷恨在心。

examples.en: Some old buildings harbor dust and insects.
examples.zh: 一些老建築裡藏著灰塵和蟲子。

examples.en: Smoking can do great harm to your health.
examples.zh: 吸菸會嚴重損害你的健康。

examples.en: There is no harm in asking for help.
examples.zh: 尋求協助並沒有什麼不好。

examples.en: The storm caused serious harm to the crops.
examples.zh: 暴風雨對農作物造成嚴重損害。

examples.en: Listening to loud music for hours can harm your ears.
examples.zh: 連續聽好幾個小時的大聲音樂可能會傷害你的耳朵。

examples.en: Pollution from nearby factories harms fish in the river.
examples.zh: 附近工廠造成的污染傷害了河裡的魚。

examples.en: The scandal harmed the company's reputation and caused it to lose customers.
examples.zh: 這起醜聞損害了公司的名聲，導致公司流失顧客。

examples.en: Too much sugar is harmful to your teeth.
examples.zh: 過多的糖對牙齒有害。

examples.en: Some chemicals are harmful to the environment.
examples.zh: 有些化學物質對環境有害。

examples.en: Strong sunlight can be harmful to your skin.
examples.zh: 強烈的陽光可能會傷害你的皮膚。

examples.en: This year's rice harvest was very good.
examples.zh: 今年的稻米收成非常好。

examples.en: The farmers celebrated the harvest with a big dinner.
examples.zh: 農夫們以盛大的晚餐慶祝豐收。

examples.en: Heavy rain reduced the corn harvest in this region.
examples.zh: 大雨使這個地區的玉米收成減少。

examples.en: They harvest the apples in October when the fruit is ripe.
examples.zh: 他們在十月蘋果成熟時採收。

examples.en: Farmers harvested the wheat by hand before modern machines became common.
examples.zh: 在現代機械普及之前，農夫們以手工收割小麥。

examples.en: We harvested enough vegetables for the winter.
examples.zh: 我們採收了足夠過冬的蔬菜。

examples.en: Don't make a hasty decision about your future.
examples.zh: 別對你的未來做出草率的決定。

examples.en: He left in a hasty manner without saying goodbye.
examples.zh: 他匆匆離開，連再見都沒說。

examples.en: A hasty answer may cause mistakes on the test.
examples.zh: 草率作答可能會讓考試出錯。

examples.en: The eggs will hatch in about three weeks.
examples.zh: 這些蛋大約三週後會孵化。

examples.en: Several chicks hatched on the farm this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上農場裡有幾隻小雞孵出來了。

examples.en: The hen sat on the nest to hatch her eggs.
examples.zh: 母雞坐在巢裡孵牠的蛋。

examples.en: The sailor opened the hatch and climbed down to the engine room.
examples.zh: 水手打開艙口，爬到下方的機房。

examples.en: Please keep the hatch closed during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間請保持艙門關閉。

examples.en: A small hatch in the floor led to the storage room.
examples.zh: 地板上的一個小艙口通往儲藏室。

examples.en: The farmer stored the hay in the barn for winter.
examples.zh: 農夫把乾草存放在穀倉裡過冬。

examples.en: The horses ate fresh hay after a long ride.
examples.zh: 馬匹在長途騎乘後吃了新鮮的乾草。

examples.en: We lay on the soft hay and watched the stars.
examples.zh: 我們躺在柔軟的乾草上看星星。

examples.en: The headline on the front page caught my attention.
examples.zh: 頭版的標題引起了我的注意。

examples.en: Her success made the headlines in every local newspaper.
examples.zh: 她的成功登上了每家地方報紙的頭條。

examples.en: Read the headline first to understand what the article is about.
examples.zh: 先讀標題，就能知道文章在講什麼。

examples.en: The company's headquarters is located in downtown Taipei.
examples.zh: 這家公司的總部位於台北市中心。

examples.en: Our team will report to headquarters every Monday morning.
examples.zh: 我們團隊每週一早上都要向總部報告。

examples.en: The police set up their headquarters near the stadium for the event.
examples.zh: 警方在體育場附近設置了這次活動的指揮部。

examples.en: It took two months for the broken arm to heal.
examples.zh: 斷掉的手臂花了兩個月才痊癒。

examples.en: Time can heal even the deepest sadness.
examples.zh: 時間能撫平再深的悲傷。

examples.en: The nurse said the cream would heal the cut quickly.
examples.zh: 護理師說這種藥膏能讓傷口很快癒合。

examples.en: There was a heap of dirty clothes on the floor.
examples.zh: 地板上有一堆髒衣服。

examples.en: He left a heap of books on my desk.
examples.zh: 他在我的書桌上留下一堆書。

examples.en: I have heaps of homework to finish tonight.
examples.zh: 我今晚有一大堆功課要寫完。

examples.en: She heaped rice onto my plate before passing me the vegetables.
examples.zh: 她把飯堆在我的盤子上，然後把蔬菜遞給我。

examples.en: The workers heaped the sand beside the road.
examples.zh: 工人把沙子堆在路邊。

examples.en: Do not heap too many boxes on the shelf.
examples.zh: 不要在架子上堆太多箱子。

examples.en: I have a blister on my left heel.
examples.zh: 我的左腳跟起了水泡。

examples.en: She wore shoes with high heels to the wedding.
examples.zh: 她穿著高跟鞋去參加婚禮。

examples.en: The heel of this sock has a small hole.
examples.zh: 這隻襪子的腳跟處有一個小洞。

examples.en: Some people believe in heaven and hell after death.
examples.zh: 有些人相信人死後有天堂和地獄。

examples.en: The old painting shows a scene of hell with fire and smoke.
examples.zh: 這幅古畫描繪了充滿火焰與濃煙的地獄景象。

examples.en: Walking in the hot sun all day felt like hell.
examples.zh: 在大太陽下走了一整天，感覺像是活受罪。

examples.en: You must wear a helmet when you ride a motorcycle.
examples.zh: 騎機車時一定要戴安全帽。

examples.en: The workers put on their helmets before entering the site.
examples.zh: 工人們進入工地前先戴上安全帽。

examples.en: My brother bought a new helmet for his bicycle.
examples.zh: 我哥哥為他的腳踏車買了一頂新安全帽。

examples.en: Please do not hesitate to ask if you have any questions.
examples.zh: 如果有任何問題，請不要猶豫，儘管發問。

examples.en: She hesitated before opening the door to the unfamiliar room.
examples.zh: 她在打開那間陌生房間的門之前遲疑了一下。

examples.en: He hesitated for a moment and then signed the form.
examples.zh: 他猶豫了一會兒，然後簽了表格。

examples.en: Can you give me a hint about the answer?
examples.zh: 你可以給我一點答案的提示嗎？

examples.en: There was a hint of sadness in her voice.
examples.zh: 她的聲音裡帶著一絲悲傷。

examples.en: The teacher dropped a hint about the test.
examples.zh: 老師透露了一點關於考試的暗示。

examples.en: He hinted that he might change jobs next year.
examples.zh: 他暗示明年可能會換工作。

examples.en: My sister hinted that she wanted a book for her birthday.
examples.zh: 我姊姊暗示她生日想要一本書。

examples.en: The manager hinted at a possible pay raise.
examples.zh: 經理暗示可能會加薪。

examples.en: The historian wrote a book about life in ancient Rome.
examples.zh: 這位歷史學家寫了一本關於古羅馬生活的書。

examples.en: Our class invited a local historian to give a talk.
examples.zh: 我們班邀請了一位當地的歷史學家來演講。

examples.en: Historians study old letters to learn about the past.
examples.zh: 歷史學家研究舊信件來了解過去。

senses.zh: 有歷史意義的；歷史上著名的

examples.en: Tourists visit the historic temple in the old town.
examples.zh: 遊客造訪老城區裡具歷史意義的古廟。

examples.en: The two leaders signed a historic agreement yesterday.
examples.zh: 兩位領導人昨天簽署了一項歷史性的協議。

examples.en: This historic building was built over two hundred years ago.
examples.zh: 這棟古蹟建築是兩百多年前蓋的。

examples.en: The hollow tree trunk provided a home for small animals.
examples.zh: 空心的樹幹為小動物提供了住處。

examples.en: The sick boy had hollow cheeks and tired eyes.
examples.zh: 那個生病的男孩雙頰凹陷，眼神疲憊。

examples.en: His promise sounded hollow to everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 他的承諾在房裡每個人聽來都很空洞。

examples.en: Many people travel to the holy city every year.
examples.zh: 每年有許多人前往這座聖城。

examples.en: The temple is a holy place for local families.
examples.zh: 這座廟對當地家庭來說是神聖的地方。

examples.en: They read the holy book together every Sunday.
examples.zh: 他們每個星期天一起閱讀聖典。

examples.en: It is an honor to meet you.
examples.zh: 很榮幸能見到你。

examples.en: The students stood up in honor of their old teacher.
examples.zh: 學生們起立向他們的老老師致敬。

examples.en: She won first place and brought honor to our school.
examples.zh: 她贏得第一名，為我們學校爭光。

examples.en: The school will honor the winners at the ceremony.
examples.zh: 學校將在典禮上表揚得獎者。

examples.en: We should honor our parents and grandparents.
examples.zh: 我們應該尊敬父母與祖父母。

examples.en: The store promised to honor the coupon until Friday.
examples.zh: 這家店承諾在週五前都接受這張優惠券。

examples.en: The students felt hopeful about the exam results.
examples.zh: 學生們對考試結果抱持希望。

examples.en: She gave her mother a hopeful smile.
examples.zh: 她對媽媽露出充滿期待的微笑。

examples.en: We are hopeful that the rain will stop soon.
examples.zh: 我們希望雨很快就會停。

examples.en: The driver pressed the horn to warn the cyclist.
examples.zh: 司機按喇叭提醒腳踏車騎士。

examples.en: My cousin plays the horn in the school band.
examples.zh: 我表哥在學校樂隊吹法國號。

examples.en: The bull has two sharp horns on its head.
examples.zh: 這頭公牛頭上有兩隻尖角。

examples.en: She screamed in horror when she saw the huge spider.
examples.zh: 她看到巨大的蜘蛛時嚇得尖叫。

examples.en: We watched a horror movie on Halloween night.
examples.zh: 萬聖節晚上我們看了一部恐怖片。

examples.en: The horror of the accident stayed in his mind for years.
examples.zh: 那場意外的恐怖記憶在他心中停留了好幾年。

examples.en: The bus runs on an hourly schedule on Sundays.
examples.zh: 星期天公車每小時一班。

examples.en: He earns an hourly wage at the coffee shop.
examples.zh: 他在咖啡店領時薪。

examples.en: Please check the hourly weather report before you go hiking.
examples.zh: 去健行前請先看每小時的天氣預報。

examples.en: The trains leave hourly for the airport.
examples.zh: 前往機場的火車每小時發一班。

examples.en: The nurse checks on the patient hourly.
examples.zh: 護理師每小時查看病人一次。

examples.en: The website updates the news hourly to keep readers informed.
examples.zh: 這個網站每小時更新一次新聞，讓讀者掌握最新消息。

senses.zh: 管家；家務管理員；房務人員

examples.en: The housekeeper cleans the whole house every Friday.
examples.zh: 管家每週五打掃整間屋子。

examples.en: The hotel housekeeper changed the towels in our room.
examples.zh: 飯店的房務人員幫我們換了房間的毛巾。

examples.en: They hired a housekeeper to help with the cooking and cleaning.
examples.zh: 他們請了一位管家來幫忙煮飯和打掃。

examples.en: She hums a tune while she cooks dinner.
examples.zh: 她一邊煮晚餐一邊哼著曲子。

examples.en: The refrigerator hums quietly in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 冰箱在廚房裡安靜地嗡嗡作響。

examples.en: Bees hummed around the flowers in the garden.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂在花園的花朵周圍嗡嗡飛舞。

examples.en: I heard the hum of the air conditioner all night.
examples.zh: 我整晚都聽到冷氣的嗡嗡聲。

examples.en: A low hum came from the old computer.
examples.zh: 那台舊電腦傳來低沉的嗡嗡聲。

examples.en: The hum of voices filled the classroom.
examples.zh: 教室裡充滿了嗡嗡的說話聲。

examples.en: The farmer kept his tools in a small wooden hut.
examples.zh: 農夫把工具放在一間小木屋裡。

examples.en: We stayed in a mountain hut during the hike.
examples.zh: 健行時我們住在山上的小屋。

examples.en: The fishing village has a few huts near the beach.
examples.zh: 這座漁村在海灘附近有幾間小屋。

examples.en: The road was icy, so the bus drove slowly.
examples.zh: 路面結冰，所以公車開得很慢。
