examples.en: An icy wind blew across the empty playground.
examples.zh: 冰冷的風吹過空蕩蕩的操場。

examples.en: She gave him an icy look and walked away.
examples.zh: 她冷冷地看了他一眼，然後走開了。

examples.en: Children use their imagination to invent stories about magical worlds.
examples.zh: 孩子們運用想像力，創作關於魔法世界的故事。

examples.en: This story asks you to use your imagination to build a new world.
examples.zh: 這個故事讓你運用想像力建構出一個新世界。

examples.en: The monster was only in his imagination.
examples.zh: 那隻怪物只存在於他的想像中。

senses.zh: 立即的；眼前的；最親近的

examples.en: The doctor asked for immediate help from the nurses.
examples.zh: 醫師要求護理師立即提供協助。

examples.en: Our immediate goal is to finish the report by noon.
examples.zh: 我們眼前的目標是在中午前完成這份報告。

examples.en: Only the immediate family came to the small party.
examples.zh: 只有最親近的家人來參加這場小聚會。

examples.en: Her speech impressed everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 她的演講讓房裡的每個人都印象深刻。

examples.en: He wore a suit to impress the interviewer.
examples.zh: 他穿西裝想給面試官留下好印象。

examples.en: The students were impressed by the new science lab.
examples.zh: 學生們對新的科學實驗室印象深刻。

examples.en: We built an indoor swimming pool at the gym.
examples.zh: 我們在健身房蓋了一座室內游泳池。

examples.en: The school has many indoor activities for rainy days.
examples.zh: 學校為雨天準備了許多室內活動。

examples.en: My mother keeps an indoor plant near the window.
examples.zh: 我媽媽在窗邊放了一盆室內植物。

examples.en: It rained all day, so we stayed indoors.
examples.zh: 下了一整天的雨，所以我們待在室內。

examples.en: Please take the dog indoors before the storm starts.
examples.zh: 暴風雨開始前請把狗帶進屋內。

examples.en: Children should not play indoors all the time.
examples.zh: 孩子們不該老是待在室內玩。

examples.en: The city has a large industrial area near the harbor.
examples.zh: 這座城市在港口附近有一大片工業區。

examples.en: Industrial waste must be treated before it enters the river.
examples.zh: 工業廢棄物在排入河川前必須先處理。

examples.en: He works for an industrial company that makes machines.
examples.zh: 他在一家製造機器的工業公司上班。

examples.en: This copy is inferior to the original in quality.
examples.zh: 這份複製品的品質比不上原版。

examples.en: Nobody should feel inferior because of their background.
examples.zh: 沒有人該因為出身而覺得自己不如人。

examples.en: The store was fined for selling inferior products.
examples.zh: 這家店因販售劣質商品而被罰款。

examples.en: Please inform me if the meeting time changes.
examples.zh: 如果會議時間有變，請通知我。

examples.en: The school informed parents about the new schedule.
examples.zh: 學校把新的時間表告知了家長。

examples.en: She was informed that her flight had been delayed.
examples.zh: 她被告知班機延誤了。

examples.en: We stayed at a small inn near the lake.
examples.zh: 我們住在湖邊的一間小旅館。

examples.en: The inn serves breakfast to all guests.
examples.zh: 這間旅館供應早餐給所有房客。

examples.en: The travelers had dinner at an old inn by the road.
examples.zh: 旅人們在路邊一家老客棧吃了晚餐。

examples.en: The inner wall of the house is painted white.
examples.zh: 這棟房子的內牆漆成白色。

examples.en: She tried to find her inner strength.
examples.zh: 她試著尋找內心的力量。

examples.en: The inner circle of the park is closed for repairs.
examples.zh: 公園的內圈因維修而封閉。

senses.zh: 無辜的；天真的；無罪的；無心的

examples.en: The judge decided that the young man was innocent.
examples.zh: 法官認定這名年輕人是無辜的。

examples.en: The little girl gave an innocent smile.
examples.zh: 小女孩露出天真的微笑。

examples.en: It was an innocent mistake, so nobody was angry.
examples.zh: 那只是無心的失誤，所以沒有人生氣。

examples.en: The mechanic will inspect the car before you drive it.
examples.zh: 技師會在你開車前檢查這輛車。

examples.en: Officers inspect the bags at the airport.
examples.zh: 機場的人員會檢查行李。

examples.en: The principal inspected the new classrooms yesterday.
examples.zh: 校長昨天視察了新教室。

examples.en: The health inspector visited the restaurant this morning.
examples.zh: 衛生檢查員今天早上來到這間餐廳。

examples.en: The inspector checked every room of the building.
examples.zh: 檢查員查看了大樓的每個房間。

examples.en: A ticket inspector walked through the train.
examples.zh: 一位查票員走過火車車廂。

examples.en: The inventor showed us his new machine.
examples.zh: 這位發明家向我們展示他的新機器。

examples.en: Who was the inventor of the telephone?
examples.zh: 電話的發明者是誰？

examples.en: My uncle is an inventor who makes small tools.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是個製作小工具的發明家。

examples.en: The old piano keys were made of ivory.
examples.zh: 這架老鋼琴的琴鍵是用象牙做的。

examples.en: Selling ivory is against the law in many countries.
examples.zh: 在許多國家，販售象牙是違法的。

examples.en: She chose a dress in soft ivory for the wedding.
examples.zh: 她為婚禮挑了一件柔和象牙白的洋裝。

examples.en: The old jail has been turned into a museum.
examples.zh: 這座舊監獄已被改建成博物館。

examples.en: The thief spent a year in jail.
examples.zh: 那名小偷在監獄裡待了一年。

examples.en: The tour guide showed us a small jail from the 1800s.
examples.zh: 導覽員帶我們看了一座十九世紀的小監獄。

examples.en: My grandmother keeps cookies in a glass jar.
examples.zh: 我奶奶把餅乾放在玻璃罐裡。

examples.en: Please pass me the jar of peanut butter.
examples.zh: 請把那罐花生醬遞給我。

examples.en: She filled the jar with water and put the flowers in it.
examples.zh: 她在罐子裡裝滿水，再把花插進去。

examples.en: I ate a jelly sandwich for lunch.
examples.zh: 我午餐吃了一個果醬三明治。

examples.en: The children enjoyed the fruit jelly after dinner.
examples.zh: 孩子們很喜歡晚餐後的水果果凍。

examples.en: Spread some jelly on the toast, please.
examples.zh: 請在吐司上塗一點果醬。

examples.en: The jet took off from the runway at noon.
examples.zh: 噴射機中午從跑道起飛。

examples.en: A private jet landed at the small airport.
examples.zh: 一架私人噴射機降落在這座小機場。

examples.en: Water shot out of the jet and cooled the garden.
examples.zh: 水從噴口射出，為花園降溫。

examples.en: The queen wore a crown covered with jewels.
examples.zh: 女王戴著鑲滿寶石的皇冠。

examples.en: The thief stole a rare jewel from the museum.
examples.zh: 小偷從博物館偷走了一顆稀有的寶石。

examples.en: She keeps her favorite jewel in a small box.
examples.zh: 她把最愛的寶石收在一個小盒子裡。

examples.en: She wears very little jewelry to work.
examples.zh: 她上班時很少戴首飾。

examples.en: The shop sells silver jewelry at fair prices.
examples.zh: 這家店以合理的價格販售銀飾。

examples.en: He bought a piece of jewelry for his mother.
examples.zh: 他為媽媽買了一件首飾。

examples.en: The journey from Taipei to Kaohsiung takes about two hours.
examples.zh: 從台北到高雄的旅程大約要兩個小時。

examples.en: We wished him a safe journey before he left.
examples.zh: 他出發前，我們祝他一路平安。

examples.en: The long journey made the children sleepy.
examples.zh: 漫長的旅程讓孩子們昏昏欲睡。

examples.en: The joyful children ran into the playground.
examples.zh: 開心的孩子們跑進遊樂場。

examples.en: It was a joyful day for the whole family.
examples.zh: 那是全家人歡樂的一天。

examples.en: Her joyful voice filled the room with laughter.
examples.zh: 她歡樂的聲音讓房裡充滿笑聲。

examples.en: This peach is sweet and juicy because it is fully ripe.
examples.zh: 這顆桃子已經熟透，所以又甜又多汁。

examples.en: He took a bite of the juicy orange.
examples.zh: 他咬了一口多汁的柳橙。

examples.en: My mother cooked a juicy steak for dinner.
examples.zh: 我媽媽晚餐煎了一塊多汁的牛排。

examples.en: Many rare animals live in the jungle.
examples.zh: 許多稀有動物生活在叢林裡。

examples.en: The explorers walked through the thick jungle for days.
examples.zh: 探險家們在茂密的叢林中走了好幾天。

examples.en: We watched a film about the jungle in class.
examples.zh: 我們在課堂上看了一部關於叢林的影片。

senses.zh: 資淺的；年少的；低年級的

examples.en: She is a junior member of the sales team.
examples.zh: 她是業務團隊裡資淺的成員。

examples.en: My brother goes to junior high school.
examples.zh: 我弟弟就讀國中。

examples.en: The junior players practice before the older ones.
examples.zh: 年紀較小的選手比年長的選手先練習。

senses.zh: 年紀較輕的人；後輩；大三學生

examples.en: He is three years my junior but has more work experience.
examples.zh: 他比我小三歲，卻有更多工作經驗。

examples.en: As a junior in college, she studies economics.
examples.zh: 身為大三學生，她主修經濟學。

examples.en: The juniors helped the seniors prepare the event.
examples.zh: 學弟妹幫學長姊籌備活動。

examples.en: There is a lot of junk in our garage.
examples.zh: 我們的車庫裡有很多雜物。

examples.en: Please throw away the junk before the guests arrive.
examples.zh: 客人抵達前，請把廢物丟掉。

examples.en: She sold her old junk at a flea market.
examples.zh: 她在跳蚤市場賣掉了舊雜物。

examples.en: My laptop keyboard stopped working this morning.
examples.zh: 我的筆電鍵盤今天早上壞了。

examples.en: He plays the keyboard in a school band.
examples.zh: 他在學校樂團裡彈鍵盤。

examples.en: You can press this key on the keyboard to save the file.
examples.zh: 你可以按鍵盤上的這個鍵來存檔。

examples.en: The kidney helps clean the blood in our bodies.
examples.zh: 腎臟幫助清潔我們體內的血液。

examples.en: Drinking enough water is good for your kidneys.
examples.zh: 喝足夠的水對你的腎臟有益。

examples.en: The doctor said her kidney was working normally.
examples.zh: 醫生說她的腎臟運作正常。

examples.en: Every classroom has a first aid kit on the wall.
examples.zh: 每間教室的牆上都有一個急救箱。

examples.en: I bought a model kit to build a small airplane.
examples.zh: 我買了一組模型組裝套件來做一架小飛機。

examples.en: He packed his football kit in a large bag.
examples.zh: 他把足球裝備收進一個大袋子裡。

examples.en: The knight rode a white horse to the castle.
examples.zh: 那位騎士騎著白馬前往城堡。

examples.en: In the story, a brave knight saves the village.
examples.zh: 故事裡，一位勇敢的騎士拯救了村莊。

examples.en: The museum has a suit of armor worn by a knight.
examples.zh: 博物館裡有一套騎士穿過的盔甲。

examples.en: My grandmother likes to knit scarves in winter.
examples.zh: 我的奶奶冬天喜歡織圍巾。

examples.en: She is learning to knit a sweater for her baby brother.
examples.zh: 她正在學著幫小弟弟織一件毛衣。

examples.en: We knit hats for the school charity sale.
examples.zh: 我們為學校的義賣織帽子。

examples.en: He tied a knot at the end of the rope.
examples.zh: 他在繩子的尾端打了一個結。

examples.en: I can't untie this knot in my shoelace.
examples.zh: 我解不開鞋帶上的這個結。

examples.en: Scouts learn how to make a strong knot.
examples.zh: 童軍學習如何打出牢固的結。

examples.en: Please knot the bag so nothing falls out.
examples.zh: 請把袋子打結，這樣東西才不會掉出來。

examples.en: She knotted her scarf around her neck.
examples.zh: 她把圍巾在脖子上打了結。

examples.en: The fisherman knotted the broken threads to repair his net.
examples.zh: 漁夫把斷掉的線打結，修補他的漁網。

examples.en: Please read the label on the medicine bottle.
examples.zh: 請看一下藥瓶上的標籤。

examples.en: The label says this shirt should be washed by hand.
examples.zh: 標籤上寫著這件襯衫要手洗。

examples.en: Each box has a label with the customer's name.
examples.zh: 每個箱子上都有寫著顧客姓名的標籤。

examples.en: Students must label every picture in the report.
examples.zh: 學生必須為報告中的每張圖片加上標示。

examples.en: Please label the boxes before we move them.
examples.zh: 搬動之前，請先在箱子上貼標籤。

examples.en: She labeled her lunch box with her name.
examples.zh: 她在便當盒上標了自己的名字。

examples.en: The wedding dress was covered with white lace.
examples.zh: 那件婚紗滿是白色蕾絲。

examples.en: My shoe lace came undone during the race.
examples.zh: 比賽時我的鞋帶鬆開了。

examples.en: She bought a lace curtain for her bedroom window.
examples.zh: 她買了一面蕾絲窗簾掛在臥室窗戶上。

examples.en: Please lace your boots before we go hiking.
examples.zh: 去健行之前，請先把靴子綁好。

examples.en: He laced up his running shoes quickly.
examples.zh: 他很快就把跑鞋的鞋帶繫好了。

examples.en: The nurse laced the boy's sneakers for him.
examples.zh: 護理師幫那個男孩綁好球鞋的鞋帶。

examples.en: Dad used a ladder to fix the roof.
examples.zh: 爸爸用梯子去修屋頂。

examples.en: Be careful when you climb the ladder.
examples.zh: 爬梯子時要小心。

examples.en: The firefighter placed a ladder against the wall.
examples.zh: 消防員把梯子靠在牆上。

examples.en: I have been very busy lately preparing for my final exams.
examples.zh: 我最近一直忙著準備期末考。

examples.en: Have you heard from your cousin lately?
examples.zh: 你最近有收到表哥的消息嗎？

examples.en: It has rained a lot lately, so the park is wet.
examples.zh: 最近下了很多雨，所以公園很潮濕。

examples.en: We heard laughter coming from the classroom.
examples.zh: 我們聽見教室裡傳來笑聲。

examples.en: The comedian filled the hall with laughter.
examples.zh: 那位喜劇演員讓大廳充滿笑聲。

examples.en: Her joke was met with loud laughter.
examples.zh: 她的笑話引來一陣大笑。

examples.en: I do the laundry every weekend while my brother cleans the kitchen.
examples.zh: 每個週末我洗衣服，哥哥則打掃廚房。

examples.en: There is a pile of dirty laundry in the bathroom.
examples.zh: 浴室裡有一堆髒衣服。

examples.en: The hotel offers a laundry service for guests.
examples.zh: 這家飯店提供房客洗衣服務。

examples.en: The children are playing on the lawn.
examples.zh: 孩子們正在草坪上玩耍。

examples.en: Dad mows the lawn every Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 爸爸每個星期六早上都會割草。

examples.en: Please do not walk on the lawn.
examples.zh: 請勿踐踏草坪。

examples.en: The roof leaks whenever it rains heavily.
examples.zh: 每次下大雨，屋頂都會漏水。

examples.en: Water was leaking from the pipe under the sink.
examples.zh: 水槽下方的水管正在漏水。

examples.en: Someone leaked the exam questions to the students.
examples.zh: 有人把考題洩漏給學生。

examples.en: We found a leak in the kitchen ceiling.
examples.zh: 我們發現廚房天花板有漏水處。

examples.en: The plumber fixed the gas leak quickly.
examples.zh: 水電工很快就修復了瓦斯漏氣的問題。

examples.en: A leak of private information upset many customers.
examples.zh: 個人資料外洩讓許多顧客感到不安。

examples.en: The cat leaped onto the kitchen table.
examples.zh: 那隻貓跳上了廚房的餐桌。

examples.en: Children leap over the small stream in the park.
examples.zh: 孩子們跳過公園裡的小溪。

examples.en: My heart leaped when I heard my name called.
examples.zh: 聽到有人叫我的名字，我的心猛然一跳。

examples.en: The dancer made a high leap across the stage.
examples.zh: 舞者在舞台上做了一個高高的跳躍。

examples.en: This new tool is a big leap for our company.
examples.zh: 這項新工具對我們公司來說是一大躍進。

examples.en: With one leap, the dog cleared the low garden fence.
examples.zh: 狗縱身一躍，就跳過了花園的低矮圍籬。

examples.en: Learning a new language takes time and patience.
examples.zh: 學習一種新語言需要時間和耐心。

examples.en: The school offers online learning for students at home.
examples.zh: 學校提供在家學生線上學習。

examples.en: Reading is a good way of learning new words.
examples.zh: 閱讀是學習新單字的好方法。

examples.en: This leather bag is soft and strong.
examples.zh: 這個皮革包柔軟又耐用。

examples.en: He bought a pair of leather shoes for work.
examples.zh: 他買了一雙工作穿的皮鞋。

examples.en: The sofa is made of real leather.
examples.zh: 這張沙發是用真皮做的。

examples.en: I read novels in my leisure time.
examples.zh: 我在閒暇時間讀小說。

examples.en: The city built a new leisure center for families.
examples.zh: 市政府為家庭興建了一座新的休閒中心。

examples.en: Many people enjoy leisure activities on weekends.
examples.zh: 許多人週末喜歡從事休閒活動。

examples.en: We sold cold lemonade at the school fair.
examples.zh: 我們在學校園遊會賣冰檸檬水。

examples.en: A glass of lemonade feels great on a hot day.
examples.zh: 大熱天來一杯檸檬水真舒服。

examples.en: She made fresh lemonade for the picnic.
examples.zh: 她為野餐現做了檸檬水。

examples.en: The leopard rested on a tree branch.
examples.zh: 那隻花豹在樹枝上休息。

examples.en: A leopard has dark spots on its golden fur.
examples.zh: 豹的金黃色毛皮上有深色斑點。

examples.en: We saw a leopard at the zoo yesterday.
examples.zh: 我們昨天在動物園看到了一隻豹。

examples.en: The students enjoy the liberty to choose their clubs.
examples.zh: 學生們享有選擇社團的自由。

examples.en: Many people fought for liberty in the past.
examples.zh: 過去有許多人為自由而奮鬥。

examples.en: The Statue of Liberty stands in New York.
examples.zh: 自由女神像矗立在紐約。

examples.en: My grandfather has lived in this town his whole lifetime.
examples.zh: 我的祖父一輩子都住在這個鎮上。

examples.en: A trip to Japan is the dream of a lifetime for her.
examples.zh: 去日本旅行是她一生的夢想。

examples.en: The store offers a lifetime guarantee on its tools.
examples.zh: 這家店的工具提供終身保固。

examples.en: The lighthouse guides ships safely to the port.
examples.zh: 燈塔引導船隻安全抵達港口。

examples.en: We climbed to the top of the lighthouse.
examples.zh: 我們爬到燈塔的頂端。

examples.en: A lighthouse stands at the end of the small island.
examples.zh: 小島的盡頭立著一座燈塔。

examples.en: She put a white lily in the vase.
examples.zh: 她把一朵白色百合插進花瓶裡。

examples.en: The lily in our garden blooms every summer.
examples.zh: 我們花園裡的百合每年夏天都會開花。

examples.en: He gave his mother a bunch of lilies.
examples.zh: 他送了媽媽一束百合花。

examples.en: The patient could not move either of his lower limbs.
examples.zh: 那位病人的雙下肢都無法動彈。

examples.en: A bird sat on a limb of the old tree.
examples.zh: 一隻鳥停在老樹的大樹枝上。

examples.en: Doctors can help people who lost a limb.
examples.zh: 醫生可以幫助失去肢體的人。

examples.en: Please do not leave litter on the beach.
examples.zh: 請不要把垃圾留在海灘上。

examples.en: Students picked up litter around the school yard.
examples.zh: 學生們撿起校園四周的垃圾。

examples.en: There was a lot of litter after the concert.
examples.zh: 演唱會結束後留下了很多垃圾。

examples.en: It is rude to litter in a public park.
examples.zh: 在公園亂丟垃圾是不禮貌的。

examples.en: Paper cups littered the street after the festival.
examples.zh: 慶典結束後，紙杯散落在街上。

examples.en: Don't litter on the mountain trail; carry your trash back down.
examples.zh: 不要在登山步道上亂丟垃圾，請把垃圾帶下山。

examples.en: The children are lively and full of energy.
examples.zh: 孩子們活潑又充滿活力。

examples.en: We had a lively talk about our summer plans.
examples.zh: 我們熱烈地聊著暑假計畫。

examples.en: The night market is always lively on weekends.
examples.zh: 夜市在週末總是很熱鬧。

examples.en: Let's meet in the hotel lobby at nine.
examples.zh: 我們九點在飯店大廳碰面吧。

examples.en: The guests waited in the lobby of the theater.
examples.zh: 賓客們在劇院大廳等候。

examples.en: There is a small café in the office lobby.
examples.zh: 辦公大樓的大廳裡有一間小咖啡店。

examples.en: Can you locate our school on this map?
examples.zh: 你能在這張地圖上找到我們學校的位置嗎？

examples.en: The company is located in the center of Taipei.
examples.zh: 這家公司位於台北市中心。

examples.en: Rescue workers tried to locate the missing hikers.
examples.zh: 救難人員努力找出失蹤登山客的位置。

examples.en: The hotel has a great location near the station.
examples.zh: 這家飯店地點絕佳，就在車站附近。

examples.en: Please send me the location of the meeting.
examples.zh: 請把會議的地點傳給我。

examples.en: This is a perfect location for a new store.
examples.zh: 這裡是開新店的絕佳地點。

examples.en: Dad cut a large log into small pieces.
examples.zh: 爸爸把一根大原木鋸成小塊。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to keep a reading log.
examples.zh: 老師要我們寫閱讀紀錄。

examples.en: The captain recorded details of the voyage in the ship's log.
examples.zh: 船長把這趟航程的細節記錄在航海日誌裡。

examples.en: Please log your work hours every day.
examples.zh: 請每天記錄你的工作時數。

examples.en: I forgot to log in to my account.
examples.zh: 我忘了登入我的帳號。

examples.en: The machine logs every change in temperature.
examples.zh: 這台機器會記錄每一次溫度變化。

examples.en: This shirt is a little loose on me.
examples.zh: 這件襯衫穿在我身上有點寬鬆。

examples.en: One of the screws in the chair is loose.
examples.zh: 椅子上有一顆螺絲鬆了。

examples.en: She wore her hair loose at the party.
examples.zh: 她在派對上把頭髮放了下來。

examples.en: In the old story, the lord ruled the whole valley.
examples.zh: 在古老的故事裡，領主統治著整個山谷。

examples.en: The lord invited the villagers to a feast.
examples.zh: 領主邀請村民參加宴會。

examples.en: He was named a lord by the queen.
examples.zh: 他被女王封為勳爵。

examples.en: Please check your luggage at the airport counter.
examples.zh: 請在機場櫃檯託運你的行李。

examples.en: My luggage was too heavy to carry upstairs.
examples.zh: 我的行李太重，沒辦法搬上樓。

examples.en: The hotel staff took our luggage to the room.
examples.zh: 飯店人員把我們的行李送到房間。

examples.en: Smoking is very bad for your lungs.
examples.zh: 吸菸對你的肺非常不好。

examples.en: Deep breathing fills your lungs with fresh air.
examples.zh: 深呼吸會讓肺充滿新鮮空氣。

examples.en: The doctor checked his lungs with a machine.
examples.zh: 醫生用儀器檢查他的肺。

senses.zh: 神奇的；魔法的；令人著迷的

examples.en: The children loved the magical story about a dragon.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜愛那個關於龍的神奇故事。

examples.en: We spent a magical evening by the lake.
examples.zh: 我們在湖邊度過了一個如夢似幻的夜晚。

examples.en: The magician used a magical hat in the show.
examples.zh: 魔術師在表演中使用了一頂神奇的帽子。

senses.zh: 磁鐵；有吸引力的人或事物

examples.en: A magnet can pick up small pieces of metal.
examples.zh: 磁鐵可以吸起小塊的金屬。

examples.en: There is a magnet on the refrigerator door.
examples.zh: 冰箱門上有一個磁鐵。

examples.en: The beach is a magnet for tourists every summer.
examples.zh: 這片海灘每年夏天都對遊客很有吸引力。

examples.en: The maid cleaned the hotel rooms every morning.
examples.zh: 這名女房務人員每天早上打掃飯店房間。

examples.en: A maid works in the big house on the hill.
examples.zh: 一位女傭在山丘上的大宅裡工作。

examples.en: The story is about a young maid and a prince.
examples.zh: 這個故事講的是一位年輕侍女和一位王子。

examples.en: The majority of students walk to school.
examples.zh: 大多數學生走路上學。

examples.en: The plan was accepted by a large majority.
examples.zh: 這項計畫以大多數票通過。

examples.en: In the survey, the majority said they like the new menu.
examples.zh: 在調查中，多數人說他們喜歡新菜單。

examples.en: Fire was a great discovery for mankind.
examples.zh: 火是人類的一大發現。

examples.en: Scientists study the history of mankind by examining ancient tools and bones.
examples.zh: 科學家透過研究古代工具和骨骼來了解人類的歷史。

examples.en: The invention of the wheel helped mankind a lot.
examples.zh: 輪子的發明對人類幫助很大。

examples.en: The floor of the hall is made of white marble.
examples.zh: 大廳的地板是用白色大理石做的。

examples.en: The little boy lost a marble under the sofa.
examples.zh: 小男孩的一顆彈珠掉到沙發底下了。

examples.en: The statue was carved from a block of marble.
examples.zh: 這座雕像是用一塊大理石雕成的。

examples.en: She solved the mathematical problem in five minutes.
examples.zh: 她在五分鐘內解出了這道數學題。

examples.en: My brother has a strong mathematical mind.
examples.zh: 我弟弟很有數學頭腦。

examples.en: The engineer used a mathematical formula to check the plan.
examples.zh: 工程師用數學公式來檢查這項計畫。

examples.en: The mayor gave a short speech at the opening.
examples.zh: 市長在開幕典禮上發表了簡短的演說。

examples.en: Our mayor visited the school last week.
examples.zh: 我們的市長上週到學校參訪。

examples.en: The new mayor wants to build more parks.
examples.zh: 新任市長想興建更多公園。

examples.en: Cows are eating grass in the meadow.
examples.zh: 牛群正在草地上吃草。

examples.en: We had a picnic in a green meadow.
examples.zh: 我們在一片綠色草地上野餐。

examples.en: Wild flowers cover the meadow in spring.
examples.zh: 春天時，野花覆蓋了整片草地。

examples.en: Volunteering is a meaningful way to spend your weekend.
examples.zh: 當志工是度過週末很有意義的方式。

examples.en: She gave me a meaningful look across the room.
examples.zh: 她從房間另一頭對我投以意味深長的眼神。

examples.en: The teacher hopes to make learning more meaningful.
examples.zh: 老師希望讓學習更有意義。

examples.en: Mom cooked dinner. Meanwhile, I set the table.
examples.zh: 媽媽煮晚餐，同時我擺好餐桌。

examples.en: The bus is late. Meanwhile, we can read in the shop.
examples.zh: 公車誤點了，這段時間我們可以在店裡看書。

examples.en: I'll finish my homework. Meanwhile, you can watch TV.
examples.zh: 我會寫完功課，這段時間你可以看電視。

examples.en: She won a gold medal in the swimming race.
examples.zh: 她在游泳比賽中贏得一面金牌。

examples.en: The medal hangs on the wall of his room.
examples.zh: 那面獎牌掛在他房間的牆上。

examples.en: Each runner received a medal at the finish line.
examples.zh: 每位跑者在終點線都領到了一面獎牌。

examples.en: The ice cream began to melt in the sun.
examples.zh: 冰淇淋在太陽下開始融化。

examples.en: Snow melts quickly when spring brings warmer weather to the mountains.
examples.zh: 春天為山區帶來較暖的天氣時，雪很快就會融化。

examples.en: Heat the butter gently until it melts, then add the flour.
examples.zh: 用小火加熱奶油直到融化，再加入麵粉。

examples.en: My mother mended the hole in my sock.
examples.zh: 媽媽把我襪子上的洞補好了。

examples.en: He mended the broken fence with some wood.
examples.zh: 他用一些木頭修補壞掉的籬笆。

examples.en: Can you mend this torn bag for me?
examples.zh: 你可以幫我把這個破掉的袋子補好嗎？

examples.en: Good sleep is important for your mental health.
examples.zh: 充足的睡眠對你的心理健康很重要。

examples.en: Solving puzzles is a good mental exercise for children.
examples.zh: 解謎對孩子來說是很好的腦力運動。

examples.en: She made a mental list of things to buy at the store.
examples.zh: 她在腦中列出了要在商店買的東西。

examples.en: We wish you a merry Christmas and a happy new year.
examples.zh: 祝你耶誕快樂，新年快樂。

examples.en: The merry music made everyone at the party smile.
examples.zh: 歡樂的音樂讓派對上的每個人都笑了。

examples.en: They had a merry time at the school fair.
examples.zh: 他們在學校園遊會玩得很愉快。

examples.en: Your room is a mess, so please clean it up.
examples.zh: 你的房間一團亂，請把它整理乾淨。

examples.en: The kids left a mess in the kitchen after baking.
examples.zh: 孩子們烤完東西後在廚房留下一片狼藉。

examples.en: The sudden rain made a mess of our picnic plans.
examples.zh: 突然的大雨把我們的野餐計畫搞砸了。

examples.en: Please don't mess up the papers on my desk.
examples.zh: 請不要把我桌上的文件弄亂。

examples.en: The dog messed the floor with muddy paws.
examples.zh: 那隻狗用沾滿泥巴的腳掌把地板弄髒了。

examples.en: He messed up the test because he was too nervous.
examples.zh: 他因為太緊張而把考試搞砸了。

examples.en: The singer held the microphone close to her mouth.
examples.zh: 歌手把麥克風拿近嘴邊。

examples.en: Please speak into the microphone so everyone can hear you.
examples.zh: 請對著麥克風說話，這樣大家才聽得到。

examples.en: The microphone on my laptop does not work.
examples.zh: 我筆電上的麥克風壞了。

examples.en: The mighty river flows through several countries.
examples.zh: 這條壯闊的大河流經好幾個國家。

examples.en: The king ruled a mighty empire long ago.
examples.zh: 那位國王很久以前統治著一個強大的帝國。

examples.en: A mighty wave hit the small boat.
examples.zh: 一道巨浪打向那艘小船。

examples.en: It was a miracle that nobody was hurt in the accident.
examples.zh: 這場意外沒有人受傷，真是奇蹟。

examples.en: Doctors called her fast recovery a miracle.
examples.zh: 醫生稱她的快速康復為奇蹟。

examples.en: We need a miracle to finish this project by Friday.
examples.zh: 我們需要奇蹟才能在週五前完成這個專案。

examples.en: The long, cold winter was a time of misery for many families.
examples.zh: 漫長又寒冷的冬天對許多家庭來說是痛苦的時期。

examples.en: He lived in misery after losing his job.
examples.zh: 他失業後過著悲慘的生活。

examples.en: Her face showed the misery she felt inside.
examples.zh: 她的臉上透露出內心的痛苦。

examples.en: The museum has a model of an old missile on display.
examples.zh: 博物館展示了一個舊飛彈的模型。

examples.en: The news reported a missile test in the distant ocean.
examples.zh: 新聞報導遠方海域進行了一次飛彈試射。

examples.en: The children made a paper missile and threw it across the room.
examples.zh: 孩子們做了一支紙飛彈，把它丟到房間的另一頭。

examples.en: Our mission is to help students learn English.
examples.zh: 我們的使命是幫助學生學英文。

examples.en: The team completed its mission on time.
examples.zh: 這個團隊準時完成了任務。

examples.en: The company sent a trade mission to Japan last month.
examples.zh: 這家公司上個月派了一個貿易代表團去日本。

examples.en: A light mist covered the mountain this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上薄霧籠罩著山頭。

examples.en: The mist made it hard to see the road.
examples.zh: 薄霧讓人很難看清道路。

examples.en: The mirror was covered in mist after the hot shower.
examples.zh: 洗完熱水澡後，鏡子上蒙了一層水氣。

examples.en: A mob of fans waited outside the hotel.
examples.zh: 一大群粉絲在飯店外面等候。

examples.en: The police asked the mob to move back.
examples.zh: 警察要求人群往後退。

examples.en: A mob of shoppers rushed into the store on sale day.
examples.zh: 特價日當天，一大群顧客湧進了商店。

senses.zh: 可移動的；行動的；行動自如的

examples.en: Most students own a mobile phone nowadays.
examples.zh: 現在大部分學生都有一支行動電話。

examples.en: The library has a mobile service for people who live far away.
examples.zh: 圖書館為住得遠的人提供流動服務。

examples.en: My grandfather is still very mobile at the age of eighty.
examples.zh: 我爺爺八十歲了，行動仍然很自如。

examples.en: I left my mobile on the bus.
examples.zh: 我把手機忘在公車上了。

examples.en: The baby smiled at the colorful mobile above the bed.
examples.zh: 寶寶對著床上方色彩繽紛的吊飾微笑。

examples.en: Please turn off your mobile during the meeting.
examples.zh: 開會時請把你的手機關機。

examples.en: The cake is soft and moist inside.
examples.zh: 這個蛋糕裡面又軟又濕潤。

examples.en: Keep the soil moist, but don't give the plant too much water.
examples.zh: 保持土壤濕潤，但不要給這棵植物太多水。

examples.en: Her eyes were moist when she heard the good news.
examples.zh: 她聽到好消息時，眼眶濕潤了。

examples.en: Plants take moisture from the soil through their roots.
examples.zh: 植物透過根部從土壤吸收水分。

examples.en: This cream helps your skin keep its moisture.
examples.zh: 這款乳霜能幫助你的皮膚保持水分。

examples.en: Moisture on the walls can cause mold.
examples.zh: 牆上的濕氣會造成發霉。

examples.en: The monk lives quietly in a small temple on the hill.
examples.zh: 那位僧侶安靜地住在山上的小廟裡。

examples.en: We met a kind monk during our trip to Thailand.
examples.zh: 我們在泰國旅行時遇到一位和善的僧侶。

examples.en: The monks get up early every morning to pray.
examples.zh: 僧侶們每天一大早就起床祈禱。

examples.en: Telling the truth is a moral duty.
examples.zh: 說實話是一種道德責任。

examples.en: The teacher gave the students some moral advice.
examples.zh: 老師給了學生一些品德上的建議。

examples.en: He made a moral choice and returned the lost wallet.
examples.zh: 他做了正確的道德選擇，把撿到的皮夾還了回去。

examples.en: The moral of the story is to be honest.
examples.zh: 這個故事的寓意是要誠實。

examples.en: Children learn basic morals from their parents.
examples.zh: 孩子從父母身上學到基本的道德觀。

examples.en: What is the moral of this fable?
examples.zh: 這則寓言的寓意是什麼？

examples.en: We stayed at a cheap motel near the highway.
examples.zh: 我們住在公路附近一家便宜的汽車旅館。

examples.en: The motel has a free parking lot for guests.
examples.zh: 這家汽車旅館為住客提供免費停車場。

examples.en: After a long drive, we checked in at the motel.
examples.zh: 開了很久的車之後，我們在汽車旅館辦理了入住手續。

examples.en: A moth flew around the lamp last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚有一隻蛾繞著燈飛。

examples.en: The moth left small holes in my wool sweater.
examples.zh: 那隻蛾在我的毛衣上咬了幾個小洞。

examples.en: Unlike a butterfly, a moth is usually active at night.
examples.zh: 和蝴蝶不同，蛾通常在夜間活動。

examples.en: The motor of this fan is very quiet.
examples.zh: 這台電風扇的馬達非常安靜。

examples.en: My brother built a small toy boat with an electric motor.
examples.zh: 我哥哥用電動馬達做了一艘小玩具船。

examples.en: The washing machine stopped because the motor broke.
examples.zh: 洗衣機因為馬達壞了而停止運轉。

examples.en: Multiply six by seven to get forty-two.
examples.zh: 六乘以七等於四十二。

examples.en: The number of cars in the city has multiplied in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年來這個城市的汽車數量大幅增加。

examples.en: Rabbits multiply quickly if they have enough food.
examples.zh: 如果食物充足，兔子會繁殖得很快。

examples.en: The detective is reading a book about a famous murder case.
examples.zh: 那位偵探正在讀一本關於著名謀殺案的書。

examples.en: Murder is a serious crime in every country.
examples.zh: 在每個國家，謀殺都是嚴重的罪行。

examples.en: My mom likes watching murder mystery shows on weekends.
examples.zh: 我媽媽週末喜歡看謀殺推理影集。

examples.en: Swimming helps build strong muscles in your arms and legs.
examples.zh: 游泳有助於鍛鍊出強健的手臂與腿部肌肉。

examples.en: I pulled a muscle in my leg during the race.
examples.zh: 我在比賽中拉傷了腿部的肌肉。

examples.en: You need more muscle to lift that heavy box.
examples.zh: 你需要更大的肌力才能搬起那個重箱子。

examples.en: I like mushroom soup on a cold day.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在寒冷的日子喝蘑菇湯。

examples.en: Don't pick wild mushrooms unless you are sure they are safe.
examples.zh: 除非你確定安全，否則不要採野生蘑菇。

examples.en: She added some sliced mushrooms to the pizza.
examples.zh: 她在披薩上加了一些切片的蘑菇。

examples.en: The disappearance of the old key is still a mystery.
examples.zh: 那把舊鑰匙為何不見，至今仍是個謎。

examples.en: She loves reading mystery novels before bed.
examples.zh: 她喜歡睡前讀推理小說。

examples.en: How the cat got on the roof remains a mystery to us.
examples.zh: 那隻貓怎麼爬上屋頂的，對我們來說還是個謎。

senses.zh: 裸體的；裸露的；無遮蔽的

examples.en: The baby was naked before the bath.
examples.zh: 寶寶洗澡前沒穿衣服。

examples.en: You can't see the tiny insects with the naked eye.
examples.zh: 你用肉眼看不到這些微小的昆蟲。

examples.en: The trees were naked after the autumn winds.
examples.zh: 經過秋風吹拂，樹木的葉子都掉光了。

examples.en: The baby takes a nap after lunch every day.
examples.zh: 寶寶每天午餐後都會小睡一下。

examples.en: I had a short nap on the train.
examples.zh: 我在火車上小睡了一會兒。

examples.en: A quick nap can help you feel more awake.
examples.zh: 短暫的小睡能讓你更清醒。

examples.en: My grandfather naps on the sofa on Sunday afternoons.
examples.zh: 我爺爺週日下午會在沙發上打盹。

examples.en: She napped for twenty minutes before the exam.
examples.zh: 她考試前小睡了二十分鐘。

examples.en: The cat likes to nap in the sun.
examples.zh: 那隻貓喜歡在陽光下打盹。

examples.en: English is not my native language, but I use it at work.
examples.zh: 英文不是我的母語，但我工作時會使用英文。

examples.en: The koala is a native animal of Australia.
examples.zh: 無尾熊是澳洲的原生動物。

examples.en: She returned to her native town after many years.
examples.zh: 多年後，她回到了自己的家鄉。

examples.en: He is a native of Taipei who knows the city well.
examples.zh: 他是台北人，對這座城市很熟悉。

examples.en: Many natives of the island work as fishermen.
examples.zh: 這座島上有許多當地人以捕魚為生。

examples.en: The guide is a native, so he knows the area well.
examples.zh: 這位導遊是當地人，所以很熟悉這個地區。

examples.en: Her uncle served in the navy for ten years.
examples.zh: 她叔叔在海軍服役了十年。

examples.en: The navy sent a ship to help the fishermen.
examples.zh: 海軍派了一艘船去幫助漁民。

examples.en: She chose a jacket in navy for the school trip.
examples.zh: 她為校外旅行挑了一件海軍藍的外套。

examples.en: Her desk is always neat and clean.
examples.zh: 她的桌子總是整齊又乾淨。

examples.en: He has neat handwriting, so it is easy to read.
examples.zh: 他的字跡工整，所以很容易閱讀。

examples.en: That is a neat idea for the school project.
examples.zh: 那是個很棒的學校專案點子。

examples.en: Water is a basic necessity of life.
examples.zh: 水是生活的基本必需品。

examples.en: A winter coat is a necessity in this cold city.
examples.zh: 在這個寒冷的城市，冬季外套是必需品。

examples.en: There is no necessity to bring your own lunch.
examples.zh: 沒有必要自己帶午餐。

examples.en: We live in a quiet neighborhood near the park.
examples.zh: 我們住在公園附近一個安靜的社區。

examples.en: There is a small bakery in my neighborhood.
examples.zh: 我家附近有一間小麵包店。

examples.en: The whole neighborhood came to the street festival.
examples.zh: 整個社區的人都來參加街頭慶典。

examples.en: His nickname is Tiger because he runs very fast.
examples.zh: 他的綽號是老虎，因為他跑得很快。

examples.en: My classmates gave me a funny nickname.
examples.zh: 我的同學給我取了一個好笑的綽號。

examples.en: Do you have a nickname at home?
examples.zh: 你在家裡有暱稱嗎？

examples.en: The students nicknamed their teacher Mr. Smile.
examples.zh: 學生們給老師取了個綽號叫微笑先生。

examples.en: His classmates nicknamed him Speedy because he ran so fast.
examples.zh: 他的同學因為他跑得很快而給他取了「飛毛腿」的綽號。

examples.en: They nicknamed the old bus Big Blue.
examples.zh: 他們給那輛舊公車取了「大藍」的綽號。

examples.en: It is normal to feel nervous before a test.
examples.zh: 考試前覺得緊張是正常的。

examples.en: My body temperature is normal this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上的體溫正常。

examples.en: The store will open at the normal time tomorrow.
examples.zh: 那間商店明天會在平常的時間開門。

examples.en: The novelist wrote her first book at the age of twenty.
examples.zh: 那位小說家在二十歲時寫了她的第一本書。

examples.en: My favorite novelist is coming to our school next week.
examples.zh: 我最喜歡的小說家下週要來我們學校。

examples.en: The young novelist signed books at the bookstore.
examples.zh: 這位年輕的小說家在書店替讀者簽書。

examples.en: The nun teaches music at a small school.
examples.zh: 那位修女在一所小學校教音樂。

examples.en: A kind nun helped the lost child find her mother.
examples.zh: 一位和善的修女幫助迷路的孩子找到她的媽媽。

examples.en: The nuns live together in a quiet house near the church.
examples.zh: 修女們一起住在教堂附近一棟安靜的房子裡。

examples.en: A huge oak grows in front of our school.
examples.zh: 我們學校前面長著一棵巨大的橡樹。

examples.en: The table is made of solid oak.
examples.zh: 這張桌子是用實心橡木做的。

examples.en: Squirrels collected acorns under the oak to store for winter.
examples.zh: 松鼠在橡樹下收集橡實，準備儲存起來過冬。

examples.en: Students observe the plants and write down their growth.
examples.zh: 學生們觀察植物，並記錄它們的生長情況。

examples.en: She observed that the shop was almost empty.
examples.zh: 她注意到那家店幾乎沒有人。

examples.en: Everyone must observe the school rules to keep the campus safe.
examples.zh: 每個人都必須遵守校規，維護校園安全。

examples.en: Wear a suit on a formal occasion like this.
examples.zh: 在這種正式場合要穿西裝。

examples.en: I have met him on several occasions.
examples.zh: 我見過他好幾次。

examples.en: Her birthday is a special occasion for the whole family.
examples.zh: 她的生日對全家人來說是個特別的日子。

examples.en: It is odd that he did not answer the phone.
examples.zh: 他沒接電話，真奇怪。

examples.en: Three, five and seven are odd numbers.
examples.zh: 三、五和七是奇數。

examples.en: She does odd jobs on weekends to earn extra money.
examples.zh: 她週末打零工賺外快。

examples.en: The cat jumped onto the table to reach the food.
examples.zh: 那隻貓跳到桌子上，想吃到食物。

examples.en: Please put your bags onto the shelf.
examples.zh: 請把你的包包放到架子上。

examples.en: The truck turned onto a narrow road.
examples.zh: 那輛卡車轉上了一條窄路。

examples.en: The two cars were going in opposite directions.
examples.zh: 這兩輛車往相反的方向行駛。

examples.en: The bank is on the opposite side of the street.
examples.zh: 銀行在街道的對面。

examples.en: The two students expressed opposite opinions during the class discussion.
examples.zh: 兩名學生在課堂討論中表達了相反的看法。

examples.en: The library is opposite the post office.
examples.zh: 圖書館在郵局對面。

examples.en: She sat opposite me at the table.
examples.zh: 她在餐桌上坐在我對面。

examples.en: There is a bus stop opposite our school.
examples.zh: 我們學校對面有一個公車站。

examples.en: She is optimistic about the future despite her recent difficulties.
examples.zh: 儘管最近遇到困難，她對未來仍很樂觀。

examples.en: Our coach is optimistic that we can win the game.
examples.zh: 我們的教練樂觀地認為我們能贏得比賽。

examples.en: An optimistic person tends to see the bright side of things.
examples.zh: 樂觀的人往往會看到事情光明的一面。

examples.en: We have an oral test in English class tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們明天的英文課有口試。

examples.en: Brushing your teeth twice a day helps maintain good oral health.
examples.zh: 每天刷牙兩次有助於維持良好的口腔健康。

examples.en: They made an oral agreement before signing the paper.
examples.zh: 簽署文件之前，他們先達成了口頭協議。

examples.en: This store sells organic vegetables from local farms.
examples.zh: 這家店販售來自本地農場的有機蔬菜。

examples.en: Farmers use organic fertilizer to help the soil.
examples.zh: 農夫使用有機肥料來改善土壤。

examples.en: My mom only buys organic milk for the baby.
examples.zh: 我媽媽只幫寶寶買有機牛奶。

senses.zh: 原本的；最初的；有創意的

examples.en: The original price was much higher than the sale price.
examples.zh: 原價比特價高出許多。

examples.en: She came up with an original idea for the science fair.
examples.zh: 她為科展想出了一個有創意的點子。

examples.en: The original plan was to go hiking, but it rained.
examples.zh: 原本的計畫是去健行，但是下雨了。

examples.en: Please bring the original and a copy of your ID.
examples.zh: 請攜帶身分證正本和影本。

examples.en: The museum keeps the original of this famous painting.
examples.zh: 博物館收藏著這幅名畫的原作。

examples.en: I prefer to read the book in the original.
examples.zh: 我比較喜歡讀原文版的書。

examples.en: We had an outdoor lunch in the park.
examples.zh: 我們在公園裡吃了戶外午餐。

examples.en: Hiking is my favorite outdoor activity because I enjoy mountain scenery.
examples.zh: 健行是我最喜歡的戶外活動，因為我喜歡山景。

examples.en: The school has a large outdoor swimming pool.
examples.zh: 這所學校有一座大型的室外游泳池。

examples.en: The children love to play outdoors after school.
examples.zh: 孩子們放學後喜歡在戶外玩。

examples.en: We decided to eat outdoors because the weather was nice.
examples.zh: 因為天氣很好，我們決定在戶外用餐。

examples.en: It is too cold to stay outdoors for long.
examples.zh: 天氣太冷了，不能在戶外待太久。

examples.en: He enjoys spending time in the great outdoors.
examples.zh: 他喜歡在廣闊的大自然中度過時光。

examples.en: Camping lets you enjoy the outdoors with your family.
examples.zh: 露營讓你能和家人一起享受戶外時光。

examples.en: The shop sells everything you need for the outdoors.
examples.zh: 這家店販售所有戶外活動需要的用品。

examples.en: Peel off the outer layer of the onion.
examples.zh: 把洋蔥最外面那一層剝掉。

examples.en: The outer wall of the house needs new paint.
examples.zh: 這棟房子的外牆需要重新粉刷。

examples.en: Scientists are studying outer space with new tools.
examples.zh: 科學家正在用新的工具研究外太空。

examples.en: Write an outline before you start your essay.
examples.zh: 開始寫作文之前，先寫一份大綱。

examples.en: We could see the outline of the mountain in the fog.
examples.zh: 我們在霧中能看見山的輪廓。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a short outline of the lesson.
examples.zh: 老師給了我們這堂課的簡短大綱。

examples.en: The manager outlined the plan at the meeting.
examples.zh: 經理在會議上概述了這項計畫。

examples.en: Please outline the main points of the story.
examples.zh: 請概述這個故事的重點。

examples.en: She outlined the picture with a black pen.
examples.zh: 她用黑筆描出圖畫的輪廓。

examples.en: I owe my brother ten dollars and will repay him tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我欠哥哥十塊錢，明天會還給他。

examples.en: We owe our teacher a lot for her help.
examples.zh: 我們很感謝老師的幫助，虧欠她很多。

examples.en: He owes his success to hard work.
examples.zh: 他的成功要歸功於努力。

examples.en: An owl sat quietly on the branch above us.
examples.zh: 一隻貓頭鷹靜靜地停在我們上方的樹枝上。

examples.en: Owls hunt at night and sleep during the day.
examples.zh: 貓頭鷹在夜間捕食，白天睡覺。

examples.en: My little brother drew an owl for his art homework.
examples.zh: 我弟弟為了美術作業畫了一隻貓頭鷹。

examples.en: The ownership of this house passed to my aunt last year.
examples.zh: 這棟房子的所有權去年轉到我阿姨名下。

examples.en: Please show proof of ownership before you pick up the bike.
examples.zh: 取車前請出示所有權證明。

examples.en: Many young people dream of home ownership.
examples.zh: 許多年輕人夢想擁有自己的房子。

examples.en: He wrote the phone number on a pad of paper.
examples.zh: 他把電話號碼寫在便條本上。

examples.en: Soccer players wear pads to protect their legs during games.
examples.zh: 足球員在比賽期間穿戴護墊來保護雙腿。

examples.en: The cat slept on a soft pad near the window.
examples.zh: 貓咪睡在窗邊柔軟的墊子上。

examples.en: She padded the box with old newspapers.
examples.zh: 她用舊報紙填塞箱子。

examples.en: The workers padded the sharp edges of the table.
examples.zh: 工人在桌子尖銳的邊角加了襯墊。

examples.en: He padded his jacket to keep warm in winter.
examples.zh: 他在外套裡加了襯墊，冬天才保暖。

examples.en: Tom is my pal from elementary school.
examples.zh: 湯姆是我小學時期的朋友。

examples.en: The two pals walk to school together every morning.
examples.zh: 這兩位朋友每天早上一起走路上學。

examples.en: I have a pen pal in Canada.
examples.zh: 我在加拿大有一位筆友。

examples.en: The king lived in a huge palace.
examples.zh: 國王住在一座巨大的宮殿裡。

examples.en: We visited the National Palace Museum in Taipei.
examples.zh: 我們參觀了台北的故宮博物院。

examples.en: Tourists lined up outside the palace gates.
examples.zh: 遊客在宮殿大門外排隊。

examples.en: She held a small coin in the palm of her hand.
examples.zh: 她手掌裡握著一枚小硬幣。

examples.en: Palm trees line the beach near our hotel.
examples.zh: 我們飯店附近的海灘兩旁種滿棕櫚樹。

examples.en: He wiped his sweaty palms on his pants.
examples.zh: 他把汗濕的手掌在褲子上擦乾。

examples.en: We had pancakes with honey for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我們早餐吃了淋上蜂蜜的鬆餅。

examples.en: Dad flipped the pancake high in the air.
examples.zh: 爸爸把鬆餅高高拋向空中翻面。

examples.en: Would you like another pancake before we clear the table?
examples.zh: 我們收拾餐桌之前，你還想再吃一片鬆餅嗎？

examples.en: A sudden panic spread through the crowd.
examples.zh: 一陣突如其來的恐慌在人群中蔓延。

examples.en: She felt panic when she lost her wallet.
examples.zh: 她弄丟錢包時感到驚慌。

examples.en: There is no need for panic; everything is under control.
examples.zh: 不需要恐慌，一切都在掌控中。

examples.en: Don't panic if you miss the bus.
examples.zh: 如果你沒趕上公車，不要驚慌。

examples.en: The children panicked when the lights went out.
examples.zh: 燈熄滅時，孩子們都慌了。

examples.en: He panicked during the exam and forgot the answer.
examples.zh: 他在考試時驚慌失措，忘了答案。

examples.en: We watched the parade from the balcony.
examples.zh: 我們從陽台觀看遊行。

examples.en: The school band marched in the parade.
examples.zh: 學校樂隊在遊行中行進。

examples.en: Children cheered as the parade passed by.
examples.zh: 遊行隊伍經過時，孩子們歡呼起來。

examples.en: Students paraded through the town with flags.
examples.zh: 學生們拿著旗幟在鎮上列隊行進。

examples.en: The team paraded the trophy around the field.
examples.zh: 球隊繞著球場展示獎盃。

examples.en: The soldiers paraded in front of the president.
examples.zh: 士兵們在總統面前列隊行進。

examples.en: The island looked like a tropical paradise.
examples.zh: 那座島看起來像熱帶天堂。

examples.en: This bookstore is a paradise for book lovers.
examples.zh: 這間書店是愛書人的天堂。

examples.en: They spent their honeymoon in paradise on a quiet tropical island.
examples.zh: 他們在一座寧靜的熱帶島嶼上度過蜜月，彷彿置身天堂。

examples.en: A parcel arrived at our door this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上有一個包裹送到我們家門口。

examples.en: I need to send this parcel to my cousin.
examples.zh: 我得把這個包裹寄給我表哥。

examples.en: The post office will deliver your parcel on Monday.
examples.zh: 郵局會在星期一把你的包裹送達。

examples.en: Please read the passage and answer the questions.
examples.zh: 請閱讀這段文章並回答問題。

examples.en: A narrow passage led to the garden.
examples.zh: 一條狹窄的通道通往花園。

examples.en: The passage of time makes memories fade.
examples.zh: 時間的流逝讓記憶逐漸淡去。

examples.en: She has a passion for music and plays the violin daily.
examples.zh: 她熱愛音樂，每天都會拉小提琴。

examples.en: He spoke about his work with great passion.
examples.zh: 他非常熱情地談論自己的工作。

examples.en: Cooking is more than a hobby; it is his passion.
examples.zh: 烹飪不只是嗜好，而是他的熱愛。

examples.en: Don't forget to bring your passport to the airport.
examples.zh: 別忘了把護照帶到機場。

examples.en: I need to renew my passport before it expires next March.
examples.zh: 我的護照明年三月到期，我需要在到期前換發護照。

examples.en: The officer checked our passports at the gate.
examples.zh: 工作人員在登機門檢查了我們的護照。

examples.en: She patted the dog on the head.
examples.zh: 她輕拍小狗的頭。

examples.en: He patted his pockets to look for his keys.
examples.zh: 他拍了拍口袋找鑰匙。

examples.en: The teacher patted me on the shoulder.
examples.zh: 老師輕拍我的肩膀。

examples.en: The coach gave the player a pat on the back.
examples.zh: 教練輕拍球員的背。

examples.en: Put a pat of butter on the hot bread.
examples.zh: 在熱麵包上放一小塊奶油。

examples.en: A gentle pat on the shoulder woke him from his nap.
examples.zh: 他被輕輕拍了一下肩膀，就從小睡中醒來。

examples.en: Teaching young children takes a lot of patience.
examples.zh: 教導幼童需要很多耐心。

examples.en: Thank you for your patience while we fix the problem.
examples.zh: 感謝您在我們處理問題期間的耐心等候。

examples.en: He lost his patience after waiting for two hours.
examples.zh: 他等了兩個小時後失去了耐心。

examples.en: Workers are paving the road in front of our school.
examples.zh: 工人正在鋪設我們學校前面的馬路。

examples.en: The yard was paved with red bricks.
examples.zh: 院子鋪了紅磚。

examples.en: The city plans to pave the old path next year.
examples.zh: 市政府計畫明年鋪設那條舊小路。

examples.en: She added fresh peas to the fried rice.
examples.zh: 她在炒飯裡加了新鮮的豌豆。

examples.en: Peas are small, round vegetables that grow inside green pods.
examples.zh: 豌豆是長在綠色豆莢裡的小型圓形蔬菜。

examples.en: My son doesn't like to eat peas.
examples.zh: 我兒子不喜歡吃豌豆。

examples.en: My brother is allergic to peanuts, so he never eats them.
examples.zh: 我弟弟對花生過敏，所以他從來不吃。

examples.en: He spread peanut butter on the toast.
examples.zh: 他在吐司上塗了花生醬。

examples.en: The farmer grows peanuts on his land.
examples.zh: 農夫在他的土地上種花生。

examples.en: She wore a pearl necklace to the wedding.
examples.zh: 她戴著珍珠項鍊參加婚禮。

examples.en: Pearls slowly grow inside oysters at the bottom of the sea.
examples.zh: 珍珠在海底的牡蠣裡慢慢長大。

examples.en: I ordered milk tea with extra pearls.
examples.zh: 我點了多加珍珠的奶茶。

examples.en: Please peel the apples before you cut them.
examples.zh: 切蘋果前請先削皮。

examples.en: The kids peeled the oranges and shared them.
examples.zh: 孩子們剝了橘子分著吃。

examples.en: The paint began to peel from the wall.
examples.zh: 牆上的油漆開始剝落。

examples.en: Don't throw the banana peel on the floor.
examples.zh: 別把香蕉皮丟在地上。

examples.en: Orange peel can be used in tea.
examples.zh: 橘皮可以拿來泡茶。

examples.en: He slipped on a peel and fell down.
examples.zh: 他踩到果皮而跌倒了。

examples.en: Penguins cannot fly, but they use their wings to swim.
examples.zh: 企鵝不會飛，但會用翅膀游泳。

examples.en: We saw a penguin at the aquarium yesterday.
examples.zh: 我們昨天在水族館看到一隻企鵝。

examples.en: The penguin waddled across the ice and slid into the water.
examples.zh: 那隻企鵝在冰面上搖搖擺擺地走著，然後滑進水裡。

examples.en: I found a penny on the sidewalk.
examples.zh: 我在人行道上撿到一分錢。

examples.en: He saved every penny to buy a new bike.
examples.zh: 他把每一分錢都存下來買新腳踏車。

examples.en: You seem quiet today. A penny for your thoughts?
examples.zh: 你今天好像很安靜。你在想什麼，說來聽聽。

examples.en: The students will perform a play on Friday.
examples.zh: 學生們星期五要演出一齣戲劇。

examples.en: The doctor performed the surgery successfully despite several unexpected difficulties.
examples.zh: 儘管遇到幾個意外的困難，醫生仍成功完成了手術。

examples.en: This car performs well on mountain roads.
examples.zh: 這輛車在山路上表現良好。

examples.en: The band gave a wonderful performance last night.
examples.zh: 樂團昨晚有一場精彩的演出。

examples.en: Her performance at work earned her a promotion.
examples.zh: 她的工作表現讓她獲得升遷。

examples.en: The new engine improves the car's performance.
examples.zh: 新引擎提升了這輛車的性能。

examples.en: You need your parents' permission to join the trip.
examples.zh: 你需要父母的許可才能參加旅行。

examples.en: She asked for permission to leave early.
examples.zh: 她請求允許提早離開。

examples.en: Do not use these photos without permission.
examples.zh: 未經許可請勿使用這些照片。

examples.en: The school does not permit phones in class.
examples.zh: 學校不允許在課堂上使用手機。

examples.en: Weather permitting, we will have the picnic outside.
examples.zh: 如果天氣許可，我們會在戶外野餐。

examples.en: Visitors are not permitted to take photos here.
examples.zh: 訪客不得在此拍照。

examples.en: You need a permit to park here.
examples.zh: 你需要許可證才能在這裡停車。

examples.en: He applied for a work permit before accepting the job.
examples.zh: 他在接受這份工作前申請了工作許可證。

examples.en: The company received a building permit last week.
examples.zh: 這家公司上週拿到了建築許可證。

examples.en: I tried to persuade my mom to let me go.
examples.zh: 我試著說服媽媽讓我去。

examples.en: The salesperson persuaded us to buy a bigger TV.
examples.zh: 業務員說服我們買了比較大的電視。

examples.en: Nothing could persuade him to change his mind.
examples.zh: 什麼都無法說服他改變心意。

examples.en: The doctor told me to take one pill after each meal.
examples.zh: 醫生告訴我每餐飯後服用一顆藥丸。

examples.en: The pill is too big for the child to swallow.
examples.zh: 這顆藥丸太大了，孩子吞不下去。

examples.en: She keeps her pills in a small box.
examples.zh: 她把藥丸放在一個小盒子裡。

examples.en: The pilot announced that we would land soon.
examples.zh: 機長宣布我們即將降落。

examples.en: My uncle works as an airline pilot.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是航空公司的飛行員。

examples.en: The pilot checked the weather before takeoff.
examples.zh: 飛行員在起飛前確認了天氣。

examples.en: The city started a pilot program for bike sharing.
examples.zh: 市政府啟動了共享單車的試辦計畫。

examples.en: The pilot study involved only twenty students.
examples.zh: 這項試驗性研究只有二十名學生參加。

examples.en: We ran a pilot test before the launch.
examples.zh: 我們在上市前先做了試驗性測試。

examples.en: Tall pine trees cover the mountain slopes near our village.
examples.zh: 我們村莊附近的山坡上長滿了高大的松樹。

examples.en: The table is made of pine and has a smooth surface.
examples.zh: 這張桌子是松木做的，表面很光滑。

examples.en: We cut a small pine for the holiday.
examples.zh: 我們為節日砍了一棵小松樹。

examples.en: She pined for her hometown while studying abroad.
examples.zh: 她在國外求學時思念著家鄉。

examples.en: The dog pined for its owner while she was away.
examples.zh: 主人不在時，那隻狗一直思念著她。

examples.en: He pined for a chance to play on the team.
examples.zh: 他渴望有機會加入球隊。

examples.en: He drank a pint of milk after the game.
examples.zh: 比賽後他喝了一品脫的牛奶。

examples.en: The recipe needs one pint of cream.
examples.zh: 這份食譜需要一品脫的鮮奶油。

examples.en: A pint is about half a liter.
examples.zh: 一品脫大約是半公升。

examples.en: The workers dug a deep pit in the yard.
examples.zh: 工人在院子裡挖了一個深坑。

examples.en: Be careful not to swallow the cherry pit.
examples.zh: 小心別吞下櫻桃的果核。

examples.en: The old mine was a dangerous pit.
examples.zh: 那座舊礦坑是個危險的深洞。

examples.en: The boy pitched the ball to his father.
examples.zh: 男孩把球投給他爸爸。

examples.en: We pitched our tent near the lake.
examples.zh: 我們在湖邊搭起帳篷。

examples.en: She pitched her idea to the manager.
examples.zh: 她向經理提出自己的點子。

examples.en: The players walked onto the pitch as the crowd cheered.
examples.zh: 觀眾歡呼時，球員們走進球場。

examples.en: The singer raised the pitch of her voice for the final note.
examples.zh: 這位歌手在最後一個音符提高了音高。

examples.en: His sales pitch impressed the customers and led to several orders.
examples.zh: 他的推銷說詞讓顧客印象深刻，並促成了幾筆訂單。

examples.en: She felt pity for the lost puppy.
examples.zh: 她同情那隻走失的小狗。

examples.en: It's a pity that you can't join us.
examples.zh: 你不能加入我們真可惜。

examples.en: He didn't want anyone's pity after failing the important exam.
examples.zh: 重要考試失利後，他不希望得到任何人的同情。

examples.en: I pity people who have to work every weekend.
examples.zh: 我同情那些週末也得工作的人。

examples.en: Nobody pities him because he never listens.
examples.zh: 沒有人同情他，因為他從不聽勸。

examples.en: She pitied the tired travelers who had missed the last train.
examples.zh: 她同情那些錯過末班火車的疲憊旅客。

examples.en: This toy is made of plastic, so it is easy to clean.
examples.zh: 這個玩具是塑膠做的，所以很容易清洗。

examples.en: Plastic can harm sea animals if they mistake it for food.
examples.zh: 如果海洋動物把塑膠誤認為食物，塑膠就可能傷害牠們。

examples.en: This factory turns recycled plastic into new chairs and tables.
examples.zh: 這家工廠將回收塑膠製成新的桌椅。

examples.en: I always bring a plastic bag when I shop.
examples.zh: 我購物時總是帶塑膠袋。

examples.en: The kids played with plastic cups in the sandbox.
examples.zh: 孩子們在沙坑裡玩塑膠杯。

examples.en: She bought a plastic folder for her papers.
examples.zh: 她買了一個塑膠資料夾放文件。

examples.en: We have plenty of time before the train leaves.
examples.zh: 離火車出發還有很多時間。

examples.en: There is plenty of food for everyone.
examples.zh: 食物多到足夠每個人吃。

examples.en: She drinks plenty of water every day.
examples.zh: 她每天喝大量的水。

examples.en: Pull the plug out of the wall socket.
examples.zh: 把插頭從牆上的插座拔出來。

examples.en: He put the plug in the sink.
examples.zh: 他把塞子塞進水槽。

examples.en: This plug doesn't fit the socket in our hotel room.
examples.zh: 這個插頭和我們飯店房間的插座不合。

examples.en: Please plug the lamp into the socket.
examples.zh: 請把檯燈插到插座上。

examples.en: He plugged the hole with a piece of cloth.
examples.zh: 他用一塊布堵住那個洞。

examples.en: Plug in your phone before it runs out of power.
examples.zh: 趁手機沒電前把它插上充電。

examples.en: A flag hung from the tall pole.
examples.zh: 一面旗子掛在高高的旗桿上。

examples.en: Penguins live near the South Pole, where the climate is very cold.
examples.zh: 企鵝生活在南極附近，那裡的氣候非常寒冷。

examples.en: He used a pole to pick the fruit.
examples.zh: 他用一根長桿摘水果。

examples.en: The students held a political debate about improving public transportation.
examples.zh: 學生們舉辦了一場關於改善大眾運輸的政治辯論。

examples.en: She joined a political party last year.
examples.zh: 她去年加入了一個政黨。

examples.en: The city faces serious political problems that require cooperation among leaders.
examples.zh: 這座城市面臨嚴重的政治問題，需要領導人合作解決。

examples.en: The politician visited our school yesterday to discuss local public services.
examples.zh: 那位政治人物昨天到我們學校討論地方公共服務。

examples.en: Many politicians promise to lower prices during their election campaigns.
examples.zh: 許多政治人物在競選期間承諾降低物價。

examples.en: My uncle wants to be a politician.
examples.zh: 我叔叔想成為政治人物。

examples.en: He is interested in politics and the news.
examples.zh: 他對政治和新聞很感興趣。

examples.en: We learned about local politics in class.
examples.zh: 我們在課堂上學到地方政治。

examples.en: Let's not talk about politics at dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐時我們別談政治。

examples.en: A new poll shows most people like the plan.
examples.zh: 一項新的民調顯示多數人喜歡這項計畫。

examples.en: The polls open at eight o'clock, so voters are waiting outside.
examples.zh: 投票所八點開放，因此選民正在外面等候。

examples.en: Our class took a poll to choose a trip.
examples.zh: 我們班用投票來決定旅行地點。

examples.en: The school polled the students about lunch.
examples.zh: 學校就午餐問題調查了學生的意見。

examples.en: They polled one thousand adults by phone.
examples.zh: 他們以電話訪問了一千名成年人。

examples.en: The company polled its customers online about the new product.
examples.zh: 公司在網路上調查顧客對新產品的意見。

examples.en: She ate a small portion of rice.
examples.zh: 她吃了一小份米飯。

examples.en: A large portion of the budget goes to rent.
examples.zh: 預算的一大部分用在房租上。

examples.en: The portions at this restaurant are big.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳的份量很大。

examples.en: The artist painted a portrait of the queen.
examples.zh: 畫家畫了一幅女王的肖像。

examples.en: A family portrait hangs above the sofa.
examples.zh: 沙發上方掛著一幅全家福肖像。

examples.en: She had her portrait taken at the studio.
examples.zh: 她在攝影棚拍了一張人像照。

examples.en: He put a movie poster on his wall.
examples.zh: 他在牆上貼了一張電影海報。

examples.en: The club made a poster for the school fair.
examples.zh: 社團為學校園遊會製作了一張海報。

examples.en: A poster on the door announced the sale.
examples.zh: 門上的海報宣布了特價活動。

examples.en: They postponed the game because of the rain.
examples.zh: 因為下雨，他們把比賽延期了。

examples.en: We had to postpone our trip until next month.
examples.zh: 我們不得不把旅行延到下個月。

examples.en: The meeting has been postponed to Friday.
examples.zh: 會議已延期到星期五。

examples.en: We took a pottery class on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我們星期六上了陶藝課。

examples.en: The shop sells beautiful handmade pottery made by local artists.
examples.zh: 那家店販售由當地藝術家製作的漂亮手工陶器。

examples.en: Ancient pottery was found near the river.
examples.zh: 河邊發現了古代的陶器。

examples.en: She poured juice into the glass and handed it to her son.
examples.zh: 她把果汁倒進杯子裡，再把杯子遞給兒子。

examples.en: Rain poured down all afternoon, forcing us to cancel the picnic.
examples.zh: 雨整個下午都下得很大，迫使我們取消野餐。

examples.en: Please pour the soup into the bowls.
examples.zh: 請把湯倒進碗裡。

examples.en: Many families here live in poverty and need help buying food.
examples.zh: 這裡許多家庭生活在貧困中，需要協助才能購買食物。

examples.en: The charity works to reduce poverty by providing education and job training.
examples.zh: 這個慈善機構透過提供教育與職業訓練來減少貧窮。

examples.en: He grew up in poverty but studied hard.
examples.zh: 他在貧困中長大，但很用功讀書。

examples.en: Her advice was practical and easy to follow.
examples.zh: 她的建議實際又容易照做。

examples.en: I need a practical pair of shoes for walking to school.
examples.zh: 我需要一雙走路上學穿的實用鞋子。

examples.en: He has no practical experience in teaching yet.
examples.zh: 他還沒有實際的教學經驗。

examples.en: Preparation for the final exam takes several weeks.
examples.zh: 期末考的準備工作要花好幾週。

examples.en: The cooks are busy with the preparation of dinner.
examples.zh: 廚師們正忙著準備晚餐。

examples.en: Good preparation will make your speech much better.
examples.zh: 充分的準備會讓你的演講好很多。

examples.en: Your presence at the meeting is required.
examples.zh: 你必須出席這場會議。

examples.en: The presence of a teacher made the students quiet.
examples.zh: 老師在場讓學生們安靜下來。

examples.en: Scientists tested the water for the presence of harmful chemicals.
examples.zh: 科學家檢測水中是否存在有害化學物質。

examples.en: The children pretend to be pirates on the playground.
examples.zh: 孩子們在遊樂場假裝自己是海盜。

examples.en: Don't pretend that you didn't hear me.
examples.zh: 不要假裝你沒聽到我說的話。

examples.en: He pretended to be asleep when his mom came in.
examples.zh: 媽媽進來時，他假裝睡著了。

examples.en: Washing your hands can prevent many diseases.
examples.zh: 勤洗手可以防止許多疾病。

examples.en: Heavy rain prevented us from going to the beach.
examples.zh: 大雨使我們無法去海邊。

examples.en: This sign is meant to prevent accidents.
examples.zh: 這個標示是為了防止意外。

senses.zh: 先前的；前一個的；前任的

examples.en: Please read the previous chapter before class.
examples.zh: 上課前請先讀前一章。

examples.en: My previous job was at a small travel agency.
examples.zh: 我之前的工作是在一家小型旅行社。

examples.en: The previous owner left a note in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 前任屋主在廚房留了一張字條。

examples.en: It is probable that the train will be late because of the storm.
examples.zh: 因為暴風雨，火車很可能會誤點。

examples.en: Rain is the most probable cause of the delay.
examples.zh: 下雨是造成延誤最可能的原因。

examples.en: A win for our team now seems probable.
examples.zh: 我們隊伍現在似乎很有可能獲勝。

examples.en: Learning a language is a slow process.
examples.zh: 學語言是一個緩慢的過程。

examples.en: The application process takes about two weeks.
examples.zh: 申請流程大約要兩週。

examples.en: Please follow each step of the process carefully.
examples.zh: 請仔細遵守流程的每個步驟。

examples.en: The bank will process your request within three days.
examples.zh: 銀行會在三天內處理你的申請。

examples.en: This factory processes fresh fruit into juice.
examples.zh: 這間工廠把新鮮水果加工成果汁。

examples.en: It took me a moment to process the news.
examples.zh: 我花了一點時間才理解這個消息。

examples.en: The film producer visited our school yesterday.
examples.zh: 那位電影製作人昨天來訪我們學校。

examples.en: Taiwan is a major producer of computer parts.
examples.zh: 台灣是電腦零件的主要生產國。

examples.en: Farmers are the producers of the food we eat.
examples.zh: 農夫是我們所吃食物的生產者。

examples.en: The shop made a small profit last month.
examples.zh: 這家店上個月賺了一點利潤。

examples.en: Most companies want to increase their profit.
examples.zh: 大多數公司都想提高獲利。

examples.en: She sold the old bike at a profit.
examples.zh: 她把舊腳踏車賣出去賺了一筆。

examples.en: The store will promote its new snacks with free samples.
examples.zh: 這家店將以免費試吃來推廣新零食。

examples.en: Regular exercise promotes good health and helps people manage stress.
examples.zh: 規律運動能促進健康，也能幫助人們調適壓力。

examples.en: She was promoted to manager after two years.
examples.zh: 她兩年後晉升為經理。

examples.en: Do you have any proof that he was there?
examples.zh: 你有任何證據證明他在那裡嗎？

examples.en: Please bring proof of address to the bank.
examples.zh: 請帶地址證明到銀行。

examples.en: Her smile was proof that she liked the gift.
examples.zh: 她的笑容證明了她喜歡這份禮物。

examples.en: This land is private property, so visitors need permission to enter.
examples.zh: 這塊地是私人財產，因此訪客需要獲得許可才能進入。

examples.en: He invested in property instead of stocks.
examples.zh: 他投資不動產而不是股票。

examples.en: Please do not leave your property unattended in the lobby.
examples.zh: 請不要把你的財物留在大廳無人看管。

examples.en: My uncle met his friends at a pub in London.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在倫敦的一間酒館和朋友碰面。

examples.en: The pub near the station serves fish and chips.
examples.zh: 車站附近的酒館有供應炸魚薯條。

examples.en: They watched the soccer game at the pub.
examples.zh: 他們在酒館看足球賽。

examples.en: Please punch two holes in the paper.
examples.zh: 請在紙上打兩個洞。

examples.en: He punched the training bag during his boxing lesson.
examples.zh: 他在拳擊課上揮拳擊打沙包。

examples.en: He punched the button to call the elevator.
examples.zh: 他用力按下按鈕叫電梯。

examples.en: We served fruit punch at the birthday party.
examples.zh: 我們在生日派對上供應水果潘趣飲料。

examples.en: The boxer landed a punch on the bag during practice.
examples.zh: 那名拳擊手在練習時一拳打中沙包。

examples.en: Would you like some punch with your sandwich?
examples.zh: 你想配三明治喝點潘趣飲料嗎？

examples.en: The puppet show was the highlight of the festival.
examples.zh: 木偶戲是這場慶典的重頭戲。

examples.en: She made a puppet from an old sock.
examples.zh: 她用一隻舊襪子做了一個布偶。

examples.en: Kids laughed when the puppet started to sing.
examples.zh: 木偶開始唱歌時，孩子們都笑了。

examples.en: This bottle contains pure orange juice with no added sugar.
examples.zh: 這瓶裡裝的是沒有加糖的純柳橙汁。

examples.en: The mountain air is fresh and pure.
examples.zh: 山上的空氣清新純淨。

examples.en: It was pure luck that we caught the last bus.
examples.zh: 我們趕上末班公車純粹是運氣。

examples.en: The teacher quoted a famous poem in class.
examples.zh: 老師在課堂上引用了一首有名的詩。

examples.en: She quoted the price of the tickets to us.
examples.zh: 她向我們報了票價。

examples.en: Can I quote you in my school newspaper article?
examples.zh: 我可以在校刊的文章中引用你的話嗎？

examples.en: I love this quote from my favorite book.
examples.zh: 我很喜歡我最愛的書裡的這句引文。

examples.en: The repair shop gave us a quote of two thousand dollars.
examples.zh: 修理店給我們的報價是兩千元。

examples.en: Her essay began with a quote from Einstein.
examples.zh: 她的文章以愛因斯坦的一句話開頭。

examples.en: The school teaches students to respect racial differences.
examples.zh: 學校教導學生尊重種族差異。

examples.en: The festival celebrates racial diversity through music, food, and dance.
examples.zh: 這場慶典透過音樂、美食與舞蹈，展現對種族多元的肯定。

examples.en: Racial equality is an important topic in many history classes.
examples.zh: 種族平等是許多歷史課的重要主題。

examples.en: Her rank in the class rose from tenth to fifth.
examples.zh: 她在班上的名次從第十名升到第五名。

examples.en: Our team fell to a lower rank in the league.
examples.zh: 我們隊在聯賽中的排名下滑了。

examples.en: The manager has a higher rank than the clerk.
examples.zh: 經理的職級比店員高。

examples.en: The magazine ranks this city among the safest in Asia.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌把這座城市列為亞洲最安全的城市之一。

examples.en: Students are ranked by their test scores.
examples.zh: 學生依考試成績排名。

examples.en: Which sport ranks highest in your country?
examples.zh: 在你的國家，哪一項運動位居第一？

examples.en: The hotel offers a low rate for students.
examples.zh: 這間旅館提供學生優惠費率。

examples.en: The birth rate in many countries has dropped.
examples.zh: 許多國家的出生率下降了。

examples.en: The car was moving at a steady rate.
examples.zh: 這輛車以穩定的速度行駛。

examples.en: Customers rate this restaurant highly for its friendly service and fresh food.
examples.zh: 顧客因為這家餐廳服務親切、食物新鮮，而給予很高的評價。

examples.en: How would you rate the movie from one to ten?
examples.zh: 從一到十，你會給這部電影打幾分？

examples.en: Teachers rated her essay as excellent because her ideas were clearly expressed.
examples.zh: 老師因為她清楚表達了想法，而將她的文章評為優等。

examples.en: Raw chicken must be kept in the fridge.
examples.zh: 生雞肉必須放在冰箱裡。

examples.en: The factory buys raw materials from local farms.
examples.zh: 這間工廠向當地農場購買未加工的原料。

examples.en: She eats raw carrots as a snack.
examples.zh: 她把生紅蘿蔔當點心吃。

examples.en: A ray of sunlight came through the window.
examples.zh: 一道陽光從窗戶照進來。

examples.en: Too many UV rays can hurt your skin.
examples.zh: 過多的紫外線會傷害你的皮膚。

examples.en: A ray of hope appeared when the rain stopped.
examples.zh: 雨停時出現了一絲希望。

examples.en: My father bought a new razor at the drugstore.
examples.zh: 我爸爸在藥妝店買了一支新的刮鬍刀。

examples.en: Be careful when you use a razor.
examples.zh: 使用刮鬍刀時要小心。

examples.en: This electric razor is easy to clean.
examples.zh: 這支電動刮鬍刀很好清洗。

examples.en: How did your parents react to the news?
examples.zh: 你的父母對這個消息有什麼反應？

examples.en: Plants react to light by growing toward it.
examples.zh: 植物對光的反應是朝光的方向生長。

examples.en: Iron can react with water and form rust.

examples.zh: 放輕鬆，離火車出發還有很多時間。

examples.zh: 晚餐後我們在沙發上休息。

examples.zh: 我哥哥是個可靠的朋友，總是說到做到。

examples.zh: 這路公車在壞天氣時不太可靠。

examples.zh: 考試結束時她感到如釋重負。

examples.zh: 這種藥能快速緩解頭痛。

examples.zh: 聽到大家都平安，真讓人鬆了一口氣。

examples.zh: 這座城鎮每年春天都會舉行宗教慶典。

examples.zh: 我的鄰居非常虔誠，經常上教堂。

examples.zh: 許多宗教建築開放給遊客參觀。

examples.zh: 你可以信賴我會準時完成工作。

examples.zh: 許多學生依靠公車上學。

examples.zh: 我們大部分資訊都依賴網路。

examples.zh: 請在飛機完全停止前留在座位上。

examples.zh: 這個星期天氣仍會很冷。

examples.zh: 今晚的音樂會只剩兩張票。

examples.zh: 他們住在山裡一個偏遠的村莊。

examples.zh: 偏遠地區的網路服務通常不太好。

examples.zh: 明天下雨的機會微乎其微。

examples.zh: 你把電視遙控器放在哪裡了？

examples.zh: 遙控器已經不能用了，需要換新電池。

examples.zh: 我妹妹把遙控器藏在沙發底下。

examples.zh: 我們需要更換走廊上的舊燈泡。

examples.zh: 網路購物可能會取代一些小商店。

examples.zh: 她用新手機替換了壞掉的手機。

examples.zh: 兩位學生將代表我們班參加比賽。

examples.zh: 在台灣，紅色象徵好運。

examples.zh: 這張圖表表示每個月的銷售量。

examples.zh: 一位業務代表打電話來向我介紹新方案。

examples.zh: 那位代表替在場所有的員工發言。

examples.zh: 這幅畫是這位藝術家早期風格的典型代表。

examples.zh: 這份調查包含了一群具代表性的學生。

examples.zh: 我們的歷史老師解釋了共和國如何運作。

examples.zh: 我要求了靠窗的座位。

examples.en: The library accepted my request for the book.
examples.zh: 圖書館接受了我借那本書的請求。

examples.zh: 這家餐廳可以依客人要求播放歌曲。

examples.zh: 你可以在七天內要求退款。

examples.zh: 她要求安排一張靠近花園、位置安靜的餐桌。

examples.zh: 這座自然保護區是許多珍稀鳥類的家。

examples.zh: 我們儲備了一些水以備緊急之用。

examples.zh: 球隊有兩名候補球員。

examples.zh: 我抗拒不了新鮮麵包的香味。

examples.zh: 這座老橋建造得足以抵禦颱風的強風。

examples.zh: 在夜市很難抗拒買小吃的誘惑。

examples.zh: 水是珍貴的天然資源，因此我們應該善加利用。

examples.zh: 圖書館為學生提供許多線上資源。

examples.zh: 我們公司最大的資源就是員工。

examples.zh: 我還沒有收到我那封電子郵件的回覆。

examples.zh: 老師對全班的回應感到滿意。

examples.zh: 因應這場大雨，學校提早放學。

examples.zh: 照顧寵物對孩子來說是一項很大的責任。

examples.zh: 訓練新進員工是經理的職責。

examples.zh: 大雨限制了我們看清前方道路的視野。

examples.zh: 市長剪綵為新圖書館揭幕。

examples.zh: 這個新濾心有助於清除水中的髒污。

examples.zh: 她想擺脫自己的壞習慣。

examples.zh: 我們請了一家公司來清除廚房裡的螞蟻。

examples.zh: 吸菸會提高罹患心臟病的風險。

examples.zh: 商店推出折扣後，銷售額在假期期間急遽攀升。

examples.zh: 落葉在潮濕的地面上很快就腐爛了。

examples.zh: 店老闆威脅要開除遲到的員工。

examples.en: For the sake of your health, you should sleep more.
examples.zh: 為了你的健康著想，你應該多睡一點。

examples.en: They moved to the countryside for their children's sake.
examples.zh: 他們為了孩子而搬到鄉下。

examples.en: Let's be quiet for the sake of the sleeping baby.
examples.zh: 為了熟睡的寶寶，我們安靜一點吧。

examples.en: She receives her salary on the last day of each month.
examples.zh: 她每個月最後一天領薪水。

examples.en: The company raised the salary of all its staff.
examples.zh: 公司替所有員工調高了薪資。

examples.en: A good salary is not the only thing I want in a job.
examples.zh: 好的薪水不是我對工作唯一的期待。

senses.zh: 令人滿意的；良好的；及格的

examples.en: The hotel room was clean and satisfactory.
examples.zh: 旅館的房間乾淨又令人滿意。

examples.en: His test result was satisfactory, but not excellent.
examples.zh: 他的考試成績還算令人滿意，但並不優秀。

examples.en: We have not found a satisfactory answer to the problem.
examples.zh: 我們還沒找到這個問題令人滿意的答案。

examples.en: I like to put tomato sauce on my pasta.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在義大利麵上淋番茄醬。

examples.en: Would you like some sauce with your fries?
examples.zh: 你的薯條要不要附一些醬料？

examples.en: The chef made a special sauce for the fish.
examples.zh: 主廚為這道魚料理做了特製醬汁。

examples.en: We grilled sausages in the backyard on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我們星期天在後院烤香腸。

examples.en: He had a sausage and an egg for breakfast.
examples.zh: 他早餐吃了一根香腸和一顆蛋。

examples.en: The night market stall sells sausages with garlic.
examples.zh: 這個夜市攤位賣加了大蒜的香腸。

examples.en: Buying in bulk can lead to a big saving.
examples.zh: 大量購買可以省下一大筆錢。

examples.en: The saving of energy is good for the environment.
examples.zh: 節約能源對環境有益。

examples.en: Her savings were enough to buy a new laptop.
examples.zh: 她的存款足夠買一台新的筆記型電腦。

examples.en: Fresh water is scarce in this part of the country.
examples.zh: 這個地區的淡水很稀少。

examples.en: Food became scarce during the long winter.
examples.zh: 漫長的冬天裡，食物變得短缺。

examples.en: Parking spaces are scarce near the train station.
examples.zh: 火車站附近的停車位很少。

examples.en: The movie was too scary for the little children.
examples.zh: 這部電影對小朋友來說太可怕了。

examples.en: It is scary to walk alone on a dark road.
examples.zh: 一個人走在漆黑的路上很可怕。

examples.en: My brother told us a scary story at camp.
examples.zh: 我哥哥在營地跟我們說了一個嚇人的故事。

examples.en: The birds scatter whenever someone walks near them.
examples.zh: 每當有人走近，鳥兒就四散飛開。

examples.en: She will scatter seeds across the garden this weekend.
examples.zh: 她這個週末要把種子撒在整座花園裡。

examples.en: Strong winds scattered papers all over the classroom.
examples.zh: 強風把紙張吹得滿教室都是。

examples.en: The scholar spent ten years studying ancient history.
examples.zh: 這位學者花了十年研究古代歷史。

examples.en: She is a well-known scholar of Chinese literature.
examples.zh: 她是一位知名的中國文學學者。

examples.en: Many scholars attended the conference in Taipei.
examples.zh: 許多學者出席了在台北舉行的研討會。

examples.en: She won a scholarship to study in Canada.
examples.zh: 她獲得了去加拿大讀書的獎學金。

examples.en: The scholarship covers tuition and living costs.
examples.zh: 這筆獎學金涵蓋學費和生活費。

examples.en: His scholarship in medieval history is respected worldwide.
examples.zh: 他在中世紀歷史方面的學識受到全世界尊敬。

examples.en: The team published a scientific study on sleep.
examples.zh: 這個團隊發表了一項關於睡眠的科學研究。

examples.en: We need scientific proof before we believe this claim.
examples.zh: 我們需要科學證據才能相信這個說法。

examples.en: She has a strong interest in scientific research.
examples.zh: 她對科學研究很有興趣。

examples.en: Could you pass me the scissors, please?
examples.zh: 可以請你把剪刀遞給我嗎？

examples.en: Be careful when you use these sharp scissors.
examples.zh: 使用這把鋒利的剪刀時要小心。

examples.en: The children cut colored paper with safety scissors.
examples.zh: 孩子們用安全剪刀剪彩色紙。

examples.en: My little brother joined the scouts last year.
examples.zh: 我弟弟去年加入了童子軍。

examples.en: The baseball scout watched the young pitcher closely.
examples.zh: 棒球球探仔細觀察這位年輕投手。

examples.en: A scout was sent ahead to check the road.
examples.zh: 有一名偵察員被派去前方查看道路。

examples.en: We scouted the area before setting up the tent.
examples.zh: 我們在搭帳篷之前先探查了這一帶。

examples.en: The company is scouting for new talent.
examples.zh: 這家公司正在物色新人才。

examples.en: She scouted several shops to find the best price.
examples.zh: 她逛了好幾家店，想找到最好的價格。

examples.en: The children screamed with joy on the roller coaster.
examples.zh: 孩子們在雲霄飛車上開心地尖叫。

examples.en: She screamed when she saw a spider on the wall.
examples.zh: 她看到牆上有一隻蜘蛛就尖叫起來。

examples.en: Fans screamed as the singer walked onto the stage.
examples.zh: 歌手走上舞台時，歌迷們尖叫不已。

examples.en: We heard a loud scream from the next room.
examples.zh: 我們聽到隔壁房間傳來一聲大叫。

examples.en: She let out a scream of surprise.
examples.zh: 她驚訝地發出一聲尖叫。

examples.en: The scream woke everyone in the building.
examples.zh: 那聲尖叫吵醒了整棟樓的人。

examples.en: He scrubbed the bathroom floor on Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 他星期六早上刷洗了浴室的地板。

examples.en: Please scrub your hands with soap for twenty seconds.
examples.zh: 請用肥皂搓洗雙手二十秒。

examples.en: We scrubbed the pots until they were shiny.
examples.zh: 我們把鍋子刷洗到發亮。

examples.en: The old pan needs a good scrub.
examples.zh: 那個舊平底鍋需要好好刷洗一番。

examples.en: Give the table a quick scrub before dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐前把桌子快速擦洗一下。

examples.en: A rabbit ran into the scrub beside the road.
examples.zh: 一隻兔子跑進路旁的灌木叢。

examples.en: A seal lay on the rocks in the sun.
examples.zh: 一隻海豹躺在岩石上曬太陽。

examples.en: The letter had a red wax seal on the back.
examples.zh: 這封信的背面蓋著紅色的蠟封印。

examples.en: Check that the seal on the bottle is not broken.
examples.zh: 請檢查瓶子上的封條有沒有破損。

examples.en: Please seal the envelope before you mail it.
examples.zh: 寄信前請先把信封封好。

examples.en: Use tape to seal the box tightly.
examples.zh: 用膠帶把箱子封緊。

examples.en: The two companies sealed the deal on Friday.
examples.zh: 兩家公司星期五敲定了這筆交易。

examples.en: The airport has tight security for all passengers.
examples.zh: 機場對所有旅客都有嚴格的安檢。

examples.en: Our apartment building hired a night security guard.
examples.zh: 我們的公寓大樓僱了一位夜間保全人員。

examples.en: A steady job gives a family a sense of security.
examples.zh: 穩定的工作讓一個家庭有安全感。

senses.zh: 資深的；年長的；高年級的

examples.en: She is a senior manager at a large bank.
examples.zh: 她是一家大銀行的資深經理。

examples.en: My sister is a senior student at the high school.
examples.zh: 我姊姊是這所高中的三年級學生。

examples.en: The bus has seats reserved for senior citizens.
examples.zh: 公車上有保留給年長者的座位。

examples.en: Seniors can get a discount on train tickets.
examples.zh: 年長者購買火車票可以享有折扣。

examples.en: The seniors will graduate in June and begin college in September.
examples.zh: 畢業班學生六月畢業，九月開始上大學。

examples.en: He is ten years my senior but shares many of my interests.
examples.zh: 他比我年長十歲，卻和我有許多共同興趣。

senses.zh: 明智的；理智的；合理的；實用的

examples.en: It is sensible to carry an umbrella in the rainy season.
examples.zh: 雨季帶傘是明智的。

examples.en: She made a sensible choice and saved her money.
examples.zh: 她做了明智的選擇，把錢存了下來。

examples.en: Wear sensible shoes if you plan to hike.
examples.zh: 如果你打算健行，要穿實用的鞋子。

examples.en: The long separation made the family miss each other.
examples.zh: 漫長的分離讓一家人互相思念。

examples.en: The separation of paper and plastic helps with recycling.
examples.zh: 把紙類和塑膠分開有助於回收。

examples.en: They announced their separation after ten years of marriage.
examples.zh: 結婚十年後，他們宣布分居。

senses.zh: 性的；有關性別的；有性生殖的

examples.en: Schools teach students about sexual health in biology class.
examples.zh: 學校在生物課教學生性健康知識。

examples.en: The law protects workers from sexual discrimination.
examples.zh: 法律保護勞工免受性別歧視。

examples.en: Sexual reproduction allows offspring to inherit traits from two parents.
examples.zh: 有性生殖使後代能從雙親遺傳特徵。

examples.en: The singer's deep voice sounds sexy to many fans.
examples.zh: 這位歌手低沉的嗓音讓許多歌迷覺得很性感。

examples.en: She wore a sexy red dress to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿著一件性感的紅色洋裝去參加派對。

examples.en: The magazine named him the sexiest actor of the year.
examples.zh: 雜誌選他為年度最性感的男演員。

examples.en: The tree cast a long shadow across the yard.
examples.zh: 那棵樹在院子裡投下長長的影子。

examples.en: The cat hid in the shadow of the wall.
examples.zh: 貓躲在牆壁的陰影裡。

examples.en: Her face was in shadow, so I couldn't see her smile.
examples.zh: 她的臉在陰影中，所以我看不到她的笑容。

examples.en: A detective shadowed the suspect for three days.
examples.zh: 一名偵探跟蹤那名嫌疑人三天。

examples.en: Tall buildings shadow the small park all afternoon.
examples.zh: 高樓整個下午都遮住了這座小公園。

examples.en: The new employee will shadow an experienced worker this week.
examples.zh: 新員工本週要跟著一位資深同仁見習。

examples.en: The children played in the shallow end of the pool.
examples.zh: 孩子們在游泳池的淺水區玩耍。

examples.en: This river is too shallow for large boats.
examples.zh: 這條河太淺了，大船無法通行。

examples.en: His shallow answer showed that he had not studied.
examples.zh: 他膚淺的回答顯示他沒有念書。

examples.en: I need to buy a new bottle of shampoo.
examples.zh: 我需要買一瓶新的洗髮精。

examples.en: This shampoo smells like lemon and mint.
examples.zh: 這款洗髮精聞起來有檸檬和薄荷的味道。

examples.en: The hotel gives guests free soap and shampoo.
examples.zh: 旅館免費提供房客肥皂和洗髮精。

examples.en: She shampoos her hair every other day.
examples.zh: 她每隔一天洗一次頭髮。

examples.en: The nurse shampooed the old man's hair gently.
examples.zh: 護理師輕柔地替老先生洗頭。

examples.en: Shampoo the carpet to remove the stain.
examples.zh: 用清潔劑洗刷地毯以去除污漬。

examples.en: The shepherd led his sheep up the green hill.
examples.zh: 牧羊人帶著他的羊群走上綠色山丘。

examples.en: A shepherd and his dog watched over the flock.
examples.zh: 一位牧羊人和他的狗看守著羊群。

examples.en: The shepherd gets up early to feed the lambs.
examples.zh: 牧羊人很早起床餵小羊。

examples.en: The teacher shepherded the students onto the bus.
examples.zh: 老師引導學生們登上巴士。

examples.en: Guides shepherd tourists through the busy old street.
examples.zh: 導遊帶領遊客穿過熱鬧的老街。

examples.en: He shepherded the children safely across the road.
examples.zh: 他帶著孩子們安全地過馬路。

examples.en: She bought a shiny new bicycle for her birthday.
examples.zh: 她為生日買了一輛閃亮亮的新腳踏車。

examples.en: The floor was so shiny that I could see my face.
examples.zh: 地板亮得連我的臉都照得出來。

examples.en: The little boy picked up a shiny coin.
examples.zh: 小男孩撿起一枚亮晶晶的硬幣。

examples.en: Can you shorten this speech to five minutes?
examples.zh: 你可以把這篇演講縮短到五分鐘嗎？

examples.en: The tailor will shorten the pants by two centimeters.
examples.zh: 裁縫師會把這條褲子改短兩公分。

examples.en: A new highway will shorten the trip to Taichung.
examples.zh: 新的高速公路會縮短前往台中的路程。
